import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace
import Mathlib.Tactic
import PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18Conditioning

/-!
The section-coordinate law behind the quotient-conditioned A18 step.

For fixed quotients `q : X' → X` and a section `s`, the unrestricted
functional coordinates are the linear functional `lambda` on `X`.  The
source sample consists of a map `R : X → B`, the reference functional on
`X'`, and the new vector `w`.  This file records the exact resulting map and
its section and distinguished-vector columns, plus its stable/expanded
codomain range.  It does not identify a globalness bound until the source
random choices are proved to be uniform in these coordinates.
-/
namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18QuotientSamplingLaw

open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18Conditioning

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K X X' W : Type*} [Field K]
variable [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
variable [AddCommGroup X'] [Module K X']
variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]

/-- The ambient version of the kernel of a functional on `A`. -/
def functionalKernelInAmbient (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) :
    Submodule K X := (LinearMap.ker phi).map A.subtype

/-- The factor map from the quotient by the restricted-functional kernel to
the quotient by `A`. Its kernel is the image of `A` in the smaller quotient.
This is the source-specific one-dimensional kernel identity used for A18. -/
theorem quotient_factor_kernel_eq_image (A : Submodule K X)
    (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) :
    LinearMap.ker
      (Submodule.factor
        (p := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (p' := A)
        (by
          intro x hx
          rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
          exact a.property)) =
      A.map (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) := by
  rw [Submodule.ker_mapQ]
  rfl

/-- The image of `A` in the quotient by the restricted-functional kernel is
the line generated by the class of any `v` with `phi v = 1`. -/
theorem quotient_image_A_eq_span (A : Submodule K X)
    (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    A.map (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) =
      Submodule.span K
        ({Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)
          (v : X)} : Set (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    let aa : A := ⟨a, ha⟩
    apply Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    refine ⟨phi aa, ?_⟩
    have hk : (aa - (phi aa) • v) ∈ LinearMap.ker phi := by
      change phi (aa - (phi aa) • v) = 0
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, hv]
      simp
    have hdiff : ((aa - (phi aa) • v : A) : X) ∈
        functionalKernelInAmbient A phi := ⟨aa - (phi aa) • v, hk, rfl⟩
    have hq' :
        Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (aa : X) =
          Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)
            ((phi aa) • (v : X)) := by
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)).2 hdiff
    have hq : Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (a : X) =
        Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) ((phi aa) • (v : X)) := by
      simpa only [aa] using hq'
    change phi aa • Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X) =
      Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (a : X)
    rw [← map_smul (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) (phi aa) (v : X)]
    exact hq.symm
  · intro y hy
    rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hy with ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c • (v : X), A.smul_mem c v.property, ?_⟩
    change Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)
        (c • (v : X)) = y
    simpa only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul] using hc

/-- For the actual restricted-functional quotient, the factor map has the
one-dimensional kernel required by the A18 section construction. -/
theorem quotient_factor_kernel_eq_span (A : Submodule K X)
    (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    LinearMap.ker
      (Submodule.factor
        (p := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (p' := A)
        (by
          intro x hx
          rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
          exact a.property)) =
      Submodule.span K
        ({Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)
          (v : X)} : Set (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) := by
  rw [quotient_factor_kernel_eq_image, quotient_image_A_eq_span A phi v hv]

/-- The map on the enlarged quotient: the old random map factors through
`q`, while the functional coordinate contributes the new column. -/
def quotientSampleOutput (B : Submodule K W)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) (w : W) : X' →ₗ[K] W :=
  B.subtype.comp (R.comp q) + (phi₀ + lambda.comp q).smulRight w

/-- On the chosen section, the resulting column is exactly the old uniform
`B`-column plus the independent `lambda` bit times `w`. -/
theorem quotientSampleOutput_section (B : Submodule K W)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (s : X →ₗ[K] X') (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) (w : W)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0)
    (x : X) :
    quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w (s x) =
      (R x : W) + lambda x • w := by
  have hq : q (s x) = x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] X => f x) hqs
    simpa using h
  have hphi : phi₀ (s x) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] K => f x) hphiS
    simpa using h
  simp [quotientSampleOutput, hq, hphi]

/-- The distinguished new column is exactly `w`, independent of both old
map and quotient-functional coordinates. -/
theorem quotientSampleOutput_newColumn (B : Submodule K W)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) (w : W) (v : X')
    (hqv : q v = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1) :
    quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w v = w := by
  simp [quotientSampleOutput, hqv, hphiV]

/-- In the stable branch, where the new vector already lies in `B`, the
sampled map still has range in `B`. -/
theorem quotientSampleOutput_range_stable (B : Submodule K W)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) (w : W) (hw : w ∈ B) :
    LinearMap.range (quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w) ≤ B := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  change ((R (q x) : W) + (phi₀ x + lambda (q x)) • w) ∈ B
  exact B.add_mem (R (q x)).property (B.smul_mem _ hw)

/-- In the expanded branch, the sampled map has range in the actual enlarged
codomain subspace. -/
theorem quotientSampleOutput_range_expanded (B B' : Submodule K W)
    (hBB' : B ≤ B') (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) (w : W) (hw : w ∈ B') :
    LinearMap.range (quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w) ≤ B' := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  change ((R (q x) : W) + (phi₀ x + lambda (q x)) • w) ∈ B'
  exact B'.add_mem (hBB' (R (q x)).property) (B'.smul_mem _ hw)

/-- The source quotient and its one-dimensional kernel coordinate give the
product coordinates used by the finite sampling equivalence. The
decomposition identity is the quotient/section equation to discharge when
instantiating this helper with A′ ≤ A and v ∈ A \ A′. -/
noncomputable def quotientSectionCoordinateEquiv
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (s : X →ₗ[K] X') (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K) (v : X')
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hqv : q v = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1) :
    X' ≃ₗ[K] X × K :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (LinearMap.prod q phi₀) <| by
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      have hq : q x = q y := congrArg Prod.fst hxy
      have hphi : phi₀ x = phi₀ y := congrArg Prod.snd hxy
      calc
        x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v := hdecomp x
        _ = s (q y) + phi₀ y • v := by rw [hq, hphi]
        _ = y := (hdecomp y).symm
    · intro p
      refine ⟨s p.1 + p.2 • v, ?_⟩
      have hs : q (s p.1) = p.1 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] X => f p.1) hqs
        simpa using h
      have hv : phi₀ (s p.1) = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] K => f p.1) hphiS
        simpa using h
      ext <;> simp [hs, hv, hqv, hphiV]

/-- Every surjection with a one-dimensional kernel admits quotient-section
coordinates. The kernel line is identified with K by its specified nonzero
vector; the complementary subspace is chosen using the vector-space
complement theorem. -/
 theorem quotientSectionCoordinates_of_kernel_line
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (v : X') (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker q = Submodule.span K ({v} : Set X'))
    (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : X →ₗ[K] X', ∃ phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K,
      q.comp s = LinearMap.id ∧ q v = 0 ∧ phi₀.comp s = 0 ∧
      phi₀ v = 1 ∧ ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v := by
  classical
  let Kq : Submodule K X' := LinearMap.ker q
  have hker' : Kq = Submodule.span K ({v} : Set X') := hker
  let eVmap : K →ₗ[K] Kq :=
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨a • v, by
        rw [hker']
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
          (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v))⟩
      map_add' := by
        intro a b
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [add_smul]
      map_smul' := by
        intro a b
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [smul_smul] }
  have eVmap_inj : Function.Injective eVmap := by
    intro a b hab
    apply smul_left_injective K hv
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  have eVmap_surj : Function.Surjective eVmap := by
    intro z
    have hzspan : (z : X') ∈ Submodule.span K ({v} : Set X') := by
      rw [← hker']
      exact z.property
    rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hzspan with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact ha
  let eV : K ≃ₗ[K] Kq := LinearEquiv.ofBijective eVmap
    ⟨eVmap_inj, eVmap_surj⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Kq.exists_isCompl
  let eSplit : (Kq × C) ≃ₗ[K] X' := Kq.prodEquivOfIsCompl C hC
  let qC : C →ₗ[K] X := q.comp C.subtype
  have qC_inj : Function.Injective qC := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hdiffK : (a : X') - b ∈ Kq := by
      change q ((a : X') - (b : X')) = 0
      have habq : q (a : X') = q (b : X') := by
        simpa [qC] using hab
      rw [map_sub, habq]
      simp
    have hdiffC : (a : X') - b ∈ C := C.sub_mem a.property b.property
    have hbot : (a : X') - b ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K X') := by
      have hbot : Kq ⊓ C = ⊥ := disjoint_iff.mp hC.disjoint
      rw [← hbot]
      exact ⟨hdiffK, hdiffC⟩
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using hbot)
  have qC_surj : Function.Surjective qC := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hq y
    let z := eSplit.symm x
    have hsum : (z.1 : X') + (z.2 : X') = x := by
      have h := eSplit.apply_symm_apply x
      simpa [z, eSplit, Submodule.coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl'] using h
    refine ⟨z.2, ?_⟩
    change q (z.2 : X') = y
    have hqsum := congrArg q hsum
    rw [map_add] at hqsum
    rw [z.1.property, zero_add] at hqsum
    exact hqsum.trans hx
  let eC : C ≃ₗ[K] X := LinearEquiv.ofBijective qC ⟨qC_inj, qC_surj⟩
  let s : X →ₗ[K] X' := C.subtype.comp eC.symm.toLinearMap
  let pK : X' →ₗ[K] Kq :=
    (LinearMap.fst K Kq C).comp eSplit.symm.toLinearMap
  let phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K := eV.symm.toLinearMap.comp pK
  have hs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id := by
    ext x
    have hx := eC.apply_symm_apply x
    exact hx
  have hqv : q v = 0 := by
    have hvker : v ∈ LinearMap.ker q := by
      change v ∈ Kq
      rw [hker']
      exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v)
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hvker
  have hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0 := by
    ext x
    change eV.symm ((eSplit.symm (C.subtype (eC.symm x))).1) = 0
    have hsplit :=
      Submodule.prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm_apply_right Kq C hC (eC.symm x)
    change eSplit.symm (C.subtype (eC.symm x)) = (0, eC.symm x) at hsplit
    rw [hsplit]
    simp
  have hphiV : phi₀ v = 1 := by
    let vk : Kq := ⟨v, by rw [hker']; exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v)⟩
    have hvsplit : eSplit (vk, (0 : C)) = v := by
      simp [eSplit, vk, Submodule.coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl']
    have hproj : pK v = vk := by
      change (eSplit.symm v).1 = vk
      rw [← hvsplit]
      exact congrArg Prod.fst (eSplit.symm_apply_apply (vk, (0 : C)))
    change eV.symm (pK v) = 1
    rw [hproj]
    have hev : eV 1 = vk := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change eVmap 1 = v
      simp [eVmap, vk]
    exact eV.symm_apply_eq.mpr hev.symm
  refine ⟨s, phi₀, hs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let z := eSplit.symm x
  have hsum : (z.1 : X') + (z.2 : X') = x := by
    have h := eSplit.apply_symm_apply x
    simpa [z, eSplit, Submodule.coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl'] using h
  have hqpart : eC z.2 = q x := by
    have h := congrArg q hsum
    rw [map_add] at h
    rw [z.1.property, zero_add] at h
    exact h
  have hCpart : (z.2 : X') = s (q x) := by
    have : z.2 = eC.symm (q x) := by
      apply eC.injective
      simpa using hqpart
    simpa [s] using congrArg Subtype.val this
  have hKpart : (z.1 : X') = phi₀ x • v := by
    have hcoord : eV (phi₀ x) = z.1 := by
      change eV (eV.symm (pK x)) = z.1
      simp [phi₀, pK, z, eSplit]
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hcoord
    change phi₀ x • v = (z.1 : X') at hval
    exact hval.symm
  calc
    x = (z.1 : X') + (z.2 : X') := hsum.symm
    _ = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v := by rw [hCpart, hKpart]; abel

/-- Source-specific section coordinates for the quotient by the kernel of a
functional on `A`. The quotient factor is surjective and has kernel the
specified line, so the abstract section construction applies without a
caller-supplied splitting law. -/
theorem quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    ∃ s : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi),
      ∃ phi₀ : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K] K,
        let q := Submodule.factor
          (p := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (p' := A)
          (by
            intro x hx
            rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
            exact a.property)
        q.comp s = LinearMap.id ∧
        q (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) = 0 ∧
        phi₀.comp s = 0 ∧
        phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) = 1 ∧
        ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x •
          Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X) := by
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let vq : X ⧸ A' := Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective q := Submodule.factor_surjective _
  have hqker : LinearMap.ker q = Submodule.span K ({vq} : Set (X ⧸ A')) := by
    simpa [q, vq, A'] using quotient_factor_kernel_eq_span A phi v hv
  have hvq : vq ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hmem : (v : X) ∈ A' := by
      have hmemker : (v : X) ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ A') :=
        LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hz
      simpa only [Submodule.ker_mkQ] using hmemker
    rcases hmem with ⟨a, ha, hav⟩
    have havA : a = v := Subtype.ext hav
    have hphi0 : phi v = 0 := by
      calc
        phi v = phi a := congrArg phi havA.symm
        _ = 0 := ha
    exact one_ne_zero (hv.symm.trans hphi0)
  have hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_kernel_line q vq hqsurj hqker hvq
  let s := Classical.choose hsource
  have hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  have hparts := Classical.choose_spec hphiSource
  rcases hparts with ⟨hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp⟩
  exact ⟨s, phi₀, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp⟩

/-- In product coordinates, every linear map whose distinguished column is
w is uniquely a pair of an old-map coordinate and an independent
functional coordinate. This is the finite fibre bijection used after fixing
the parent subspace and the expanded codomain branch. -/
def productMapFromCoordinates {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
      (p : (X →ₗ[K] B) × (X →ₗ[K] K)) :
    X × K →ₗ[K] B × K :=
  LinearMap.prod
    (p.1.comp (LinearMap.fst K X K))
    (p.2.comp (LinearMap.fst K X K) + LinearMap.snd K X K)

/-- The coordinate map for the one-vector codomain extension. -/
def expandedCodomainCoordinateMap (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) :
    (B × K) →ₗ[K] spanExtensionSubmodule B w where
  toFun p := ⟨(p.1 : W) + p.2 • w, by
    dsimp [spanExtensionSubmodule]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left p.1.property)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))))⟩
  map_add' p q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (↑p.1 + ↑q.1) + (p.2 + q.2) • w =
      (↑p.1 + p.2 • w) + (↑q.1 + q.2 • w)
    rw [add_smul]
    abel
  map_smul' c p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (c • (p.1 : W)) + (c • p.2) • w = c • ((p.1 : W) + p.2 • w)
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]

/-- The one-vector extension `B ⊔ span{w}` is linearly equivalent to
`B × K` when `w` is outside `B`. This is the actual codomain coordinate
system for the expanded branch. -/
noncomputable def expandedCodomainReconstructionEquiv (B : Submodule K W) (w : W)
    (hw : w ∉ B) : (B × K) ≃ₗ[K] spanExtensionSubmodule B w :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (expandedCodomainCoordinateMap B w) <| by
    constructor
    · intro p q hpq
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : spanExtensionSubmodule B w => (z : W)) hpq
      change (p.1 : W) + p.2 • w = (q.1 : W) + q.2 • w at hv
      have hcoef : (p.2 - q.2) • w = (q.1 : W) - (p.1 : W) := by
        have hsum : p.2 • w - q.2 • w = (q.1 : W) - (p.1 : W) := by
          calc
            p.2 • w - q.2 • w =
                ((p.1 : W) + p.2 • w) - ((p.1 : W) + q.2 • w) := by abel
            _ = ((q.1 : W) + q.2 • w) - ((p.1 : W) + q.2 • w) := by rw [hv]
            _ = (q.1 : W) - (p.1 : W) := by abel
        simpa only [sub_smul] using hsum
      by_cases hk : p.2 = q.2
      · have hb : (p.1 : W) = q.1 := by
          have h := hv
          rw [hk] at h
          exact add_right_cancel h
        exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hb) hk
      · have hmem : (p.2 - q.2) • w ∈ B := by
          rw [hcoef]
          exact B.sub_mem q.1.property p.1.property
        have hwB : w ∈ B := by
          have hscaled := B.smul_mem (p.2 - q.2)⁻¹ hmem
          simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hk)] using hscaled
        exact (hw hwB).elim
    · intro z
      rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp z.property with ⟨b, hb, c, hc, hbc⟩
      rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hc with ⟨k, hk⟩
      refine ⟨(⟨b, hb⟩, k), ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (b : W) + k • w = (z : W)
      rw [← hbc, ← hk]
/-- The forward coordinate map on the actual enlarged codomain. -/
noncomputable def expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv (B : Submodule K W) (w : W)
    (hw : w ∉ B) : spanExtensionSubmodule B w ≃ₗ[K] B × K :=
  (expandedCodomainReconstructionEquiv B w hw).symm
/-- The distinguished outside vector has coordinate `(0,1)` in the actual
expanded-codomain equivalence. -/
theorem expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv_newColumn (B : Submodule K W) (w : W)
    (hw : w ∉ B) :
    expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv B w hw
      ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩ = (0, 1) := by
  let e := expandedCodomainReconstructionEquiv B w hw
  have he : e (0, 1) =
      (⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩ : spanExtensionSubmodule B w) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (0 : W) + (1 : K) • w = w
    simp
  change e.symm
      ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩ = (0, 1)
  rw [← he]
  exact e.symm_apply_apply (0, 1)

def coordinatesOfMap {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
      (eD : X' ≃ₗ[K] X × K) (eC : W ≃ₗ[K] B × K)
    (N : X' →ₗ[K] W) : (X →ₗ[K] B) × (X →ₗ[K] K) :=
  let T := eC.toLinearMap.comp (N.comp eD.symm.toLinearMap)
  ( (LinearMap.fst K B K).comp
      (T.comp (LinearMap.inl K X K)),
    (LinearMap.snd K B K).comp
      (T.comp (LinearMap.inl K X K)) )

noncomputable def fixedColumnCoordinateEquiv {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] [Module K B]
    (eD : X' ≃ₗ[K] X × K) (eC : W ≃ₗ[K] (B × K))
    (v : X') (w : W) (hDv : eD v = (0, 1)) (hCw : eC w = (0, 1)) :
    {N : X' →ₗ[K] W // N v = w} ≃
      (X →ₗ[K] B) × (X →ₗ[K] K) where
  toFun N := coordinatesOfMap eD eC N.1
  invFun p := by
    let T := productMapFromCoordinates p
    refine ⟨eC.symm.toLinearMap.comp (T.comp eD.toLinearMap), ?_⟩
    have hT : T (0, 1) = (0, 1) := by
      simp [T, productMapFromCoordinates]
    have hsymm : eC.symm (0, 1) = w := by
      apply eC.injective
      simpa using hCw.symm
    change eC.symm (T (eD v)) = w
    rw [hDv, hT, hsymm]
  left_inv N := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    let T := eC.toLinearMap.comp (N.1.comp eD.symm.toLinearMap)
    let P := coordinatesOfMap eD eC N.1
    have hT : T (0, 1) = (0, 1) := by
      have h := congrArg eC.toLinearMap N.2
      have hvD : eD.symm (0, 1) = v := by
        apply eD.injective
        simpa [hDv]
      change eC.toLinearMap (N.1 (eD.symm (0, 1))) = (0, 1)
      rw [hvD, N.2]
      exact hCw
    apply eC.injective
    have hrhs : eC (N.1 z) = T (eD z) := by
      dsimp [T]
      simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    calc
      eC (eC.symm (productMapFromCoordinates P (eD z))) =
          productMapFromCoordinates P (eD z) := eC.apply_symm_apply _
      _ = T (eD z) := by
        symm
        have hdecomp : eD z = ((eD z).1, 0) + (0, (eD z).2) := by
          ext <;> simp
        rw [hdecomp, map_add]
        have hsecond :
            T (0, (eD z).2) = (eD z).2 • (0, 1) := by
          rw [show (0, (eD z).2) = (eD z).2 • ((0, 1) : X × K) by ext <;> simp]
          rw [map_smul, hT]
        rw [hsecond]
        have hfirst :
            T ((eD z).1, 0) = (P.1 (eD z).1, P.2 (eD z).1) := by
          simp only [T, P, coordinatesOfMap, LinearMap.comp_apply,
            LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, LinearMap.inl_apply]
        rw [hfirst]
        simp [productMapFromCoordinates]
      _ = eC (N.1 z) := hrhs.symm
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      simp [coordinatesOfMap, productMapFromCoordinates,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      simp [coordinatesOfMap, productMapFromCoordinates,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The quotient section and the actual one-vector codomain extension give
an explicit coordinate bijection for maps with the sampled distinguished
column. The hypotheses are the quotient/section identities, not a sampling
law or energy bound. -/
noncomputable def quotientAppendSamplingEquiv
    (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) (hw : w ∉ B)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (s : X →ₗ[K] X') (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K) (v : X')
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hqv : q v = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1) :
    {N : X' →ₗ[K] spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
      N v = ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩} ≃
      (X →ₗ[K] B) × (X →ₗ[K] K) := by
  let eD : X' ≃ₗ[K] X × K :=
    quotientSectionCoordinateEquiv q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV
  let eC : spanExtensionSubmodule B w ≃ₗ[K] B × K :=
    expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv B w hw
  have hDv : eD v = (0, 1) := by
    change (q v, phi₀ v) = (0, 1)
    exact Prod.ext hqv hphiV
  have hCw := expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv_newColumn B w hw
  exact fixedColumnCoordinateEquiv eD eC v
    ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩ hDv hCw

/-- The source-shaped finite-coordinate bijection for a restricted
functional kernel and an appended vector outside `B`. This derives the
quotient section internally; callers need not assume a section, a fibre law,
or an energy estimate. -/
noncomputable def restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) (hw : w ∉ B) :
    {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
          spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
      N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
        ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
          (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩} ≃
      ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] K) := by
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  have hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv
  let s := Classical.choose hsource
  have hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  have hparts := Classical.choose_spec hphiSource
  rcases hparts with ⟨hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp⟩
  exact quotientAppendSamplingEquiv B w hw q s phi₀
    (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV

/-- The map assembled from the source section and independent functional is
exactly the inverse-coordinate representative, after coercing its image into
the one-vector extension. -/
theorem quotientAppendSamplingEquiv_symm_apply
    (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) (hw : w ∉ B)
    (q : X' →ₗ[K] X) (s : X →ₗ[K] X') (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[K] K) (v : X')
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hqv : q v = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1)
    (R : X →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[K] K) :
    (spanExtensionSubmodule B w).subtype.comp
      ((quotientAppendSamplingEquiv B w hw q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV).symm
        (R, lambda)).1 = quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w := by
  let eD : X' ≃ₗ[K] X × K :=
    quotientSectionCoordinateEquiv q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV
  let eC : spanExtensionSubmodule B w ≃ₗ[K] B × K :=
    expandedCodomainCoordinateEquiv B w hw
  let w' : spanExtensionSubmodule B w :=
    ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩
  have hRange : ∀ x, quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w x ∈
      spanExtensionSubmodule B w := by
    intro x
    have hx : quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w x ∈
        LinearMap.range (quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w) := ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact quotientSampleOutput_range_expanded B (spanExtensionSubmodule B w)
      (le_sup_left) q phi₀ R lambda w (Submodule.mem_sup_right
        (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))) hx
  let N : X' →ₗ[K] spanExtensionSubmodule B w :=
    (quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w).codRestrict _ hRange
  have hNpoint : N v = w' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact quotientSampleOutput_newColumn B q phi₀ R lambda w v hqv hphiV
  have hsection_at (x : X) : eD (s x) = (x, 0) := by
    change (q (s x), phi₀ (s x)) = (x, 0)
    exact Prod.ext
      (by
        have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] X => f x) hqs
        simpa using h)
      (by
        have h := congrArg (fun f : X →ₗ[K] K => f x) hphiS
        simpa using h)
  have hinverse_section (x : X) : eD.symm (x, 0) = s x := by
    apply eD.injective
    rw [eD.apply_symm_apply, hsection_at]
  have hcoordinates (x : X) : eC (N (s x)) = (R x, lambda x) := by
    let eRec := expandedCodomainReconstructionEquiv B w hw
    have hrec : eRec (R x, lambda x) = N (s x) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      calc
        (eRec (R x, lambda x) : W) = (R x : W) + lambda x • w := by
          rfl
        _ = quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w (s x) :=
          (quotientSampleOutput_section B q s phi₀ R lambda w hqs hphiS x).symm
        _ = (N (s x) : W) := rfl
    change eRec.symm (N (s x)) = (R x, lambda x)
    rw [← hrec]
    exact eRec.symm_apply_apply (R x, lambda x)
  have hcoords :
      quotientAppendSamplingEquiv B w hw q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV
        ⟨N, hNpoint⟩ = (R, lambda) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      dsimp [quotientAppendSamplingEquiv, fixedColumnCoordinateEquiv]
      change (eC (N (eD.symm (x, 0)))).1 = R x
      rw [hinverse_section x, hcoordinates x]
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      dsimp [quotientAppendSamplingEquiv, fixedColumnCoordinateEquiv]
      change (eC (N (eD.symm (x, 0)))).2 = lambda x
      rw [hinverse_section x, hcoordinates x]
  have hInverse :
      (quotientAppendSamplingEquiv B w hw q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV).symm
        (R, lambda) = ⟨N, hNpoint⟩ := by
    apply (quotientAppendSamplingEquiv B w hw q s phi₀ v
      hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV).injective
    simpa using hcoords.symm
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hInverseVal := congrArg (fun n => n.1) hInverse
  have hcoerce := congrArg (fun f : X' →ₗ[K] spanExtensionSubmodule B w =>
      (spanExtensionSubmodule B w).subtype.comp f) hInverseVal
  have hNcoerce : (spanExtensionSubmodule B w).subtype.comp N =
      quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w := by
    ext y
    simp [N, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply]
  have hfinal := hcoerce.trans hNcoerce
  exact congrArg (fun f : X' →ₗ[K] W => f x) hfinal

/-- The finite-sum pushforward for the source-specific quotient fibre. This
is the exact uniform-coordinate law induced by the bijection, before any
conditioning on the outside-column event or any energy estimate. -/
theorem restrictedFunctionalAppendSampling_sum
    [Fintype X] [Fintype K] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) (hw : w ∉ B)
    (g : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
              spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
          N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
            ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
              (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩} → Real) :
    (∑ N : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
                spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
            N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
              ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
                (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩}, g N) =
      ∑ p : ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] K),
        g ((restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B w hw).symm p) := by
  classical
  exact (Equiv.sum_comp
    (restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B w hw).symm
    (fun N => g N)).symm

/-- The normalized finite uniform mean is preserved by this source
equivalence for each fixed outside vector. The later source-level branch
conditioning and energy/Jensen estimate remain separate. -/
theorem restrictedFunctionalAppendSampling_mean
    [Fintype X] [Fintype K] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B : Submodule K W) (w : W) (hw : w ∉ B)
    (g : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
              spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
          N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
            ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
              (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩} → Real) :
    (∑ N : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
                spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
            N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
              ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
                (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩}, g N) /
        (Fintype.card {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[K]
                spanExtensionSubmodule B w //
            N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) =
              ⟨w, Submodule.mem_sup_right
                (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w))⟩} : Real) =
      (∑ p : ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] K),
        g ((restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B w hw).symm p)) /
        (Fintype.card (((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] K)) : Real) := by
  rw [restrictedFunctionalAppendSampling_sum A phi v hv B w hw g,
    Fintype.card_congr (restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B w hw)]
end

/-!
Exact carrier identity for the expanded branch of the A18 column split.
For a codimension-one extension `B ≤ B'`, every vector outside `B` spans
`B'` together with `B`. This is the typed bridge needed to reindex actual
outside-column maps by their column value.
-/
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18SourceConditioning

open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18Conditioning
open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18QuotientSamplingLaw

/-- An outside vector in a one-dimensional extension generates the actual
expanded codomain together with the old subspace. -/
theorem spanExtension_eq_of_codim_one
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (w : B') (hw : (w : W) ∉ B) :
    spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) = B' := by
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
  · intro x hx
    rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx with ⟨b, hb, c, hc, hbc⟩
    rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hc with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rw [← hbc, ← ha]
    exact B'.add_mem (hB hb) (B'.smul_mem a w.property)
  · rw [spanExtensionSubmodule, Submodule.finrank_sup_span_singleton hw]
    exact hdim.symm

/-- Partition actual linear maps into fibers of their distinguished column.
This is the exact dependent sum behind the expanded A18 branch; the next
step transports each fiber through the quotient-section coordinates. -/
noncomputable def outsideColumnSigmaEquiv
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B') (v : X) :
    {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} ≃
      Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
        {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // F v = w} where
  toFun F := ⟨⟨F.1 v, F.2⟩, ⟨F.1, rfl⟩⟩
  invFun p := ⟨p.2.1, by simpa only [p.2.2] using p.1.2⟩
  left_inv F := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  right_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨w, ⟨F, hF⟩⟩
    -- `hF : F v = ↑w`. The sigma index is that subtype, so compare indices by
    -- `Subtype.ext` and the stored maps by `Sigma.subtype_ext`.
    apply Sigma.subtype_ext
    · exact Subtype.ext hF
    · rfl

/-! The evaluation fibers all have the same size when the distinguished
column vector is nonzero. The translating functional is kept explicit so
the source-specific theorem below can construct it from `phi v = 1`. -/

noncomputable def evaluationFiberEquiv
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (v : X) (ell : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (hell : ell v = 1)
    (y z : W) :
    {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] W // F v = y} ≃
      {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] W // F v = z} where
  toFun F := ⟨F.1 + ell.smulRight (z - y), by
    simp [F.2, hell]⟩
  invFun F := ⟨F.1 - ell.smulRight (z - y), by
    simp [F.2, hell]⟩
  left_inv F := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
  right_inv F := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]

/-- The actual outside-column event has exactly half the full map space in a
binary codimension-one extension, provided the sampled quotient vector is
nonzero. This establishes the event mass from the source geometry; it is not
an assumed density premise. -/
theorem outsideColumn_card_half
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (v : X) (ell : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (hell : ell v = 1) :
    Fintype.card (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') =
      2 * Fintype.card {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} := by
  classical
  let Fib (y : B') := {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // F v = y}
  have hfib (y : B') : Fintype.card (Fib y) = Fintype.card (Fib 0) := by
    exact Fintype.card_congr (evaluationFiberEquiv v ell hell y 0)
  let allColumns : (Σ y : B', Fib y) ≃ (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') :=
    { toFun := fun p => p.2.1
      invFun := fun F => ⟨F v, ⟨F, rfl⟩⟩
      left_inv := fun p => by
        rcases p with ⟨y, ⟨F, hF⟩⟩
        apply Sigma.subtype_ext hF
        rfl
      right_inv := fun F => rfl }

  have htotal : Fintype.card (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') =
      Fintype.card B' * Fintype.card (Fib 0) := by
    calc
      Fintype.card (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') = Fintype.card (Σ y : B', Fib y) :=
        (Fintype.card_congr allColumns).symm
      _ = Fintype.card B' * Fintype.card (Fib 0) := by
        rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
        simp_rw [hfib]
        simp
  have houtside :
      Fintype.card {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} =
        Fintype.card {y : B' // (y : W) ∉ B} * Fintype.card (Fib 0) := by
    calc
      _ = Fintype.card (Σ y : {y : B' // (y : W) ∉ B}, Fib y.1) :=
        Fintype.card_congr (outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB v)
      _ = Fintype.card {y : B' // (y : W) ∉ B} * Fintype.card (Fib 0) := by
        rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
        simp_rw [hfib]
        simp
  have hcomp : Fintype.card {y : B' // (y : W) ∉ B} = Fintype.card B := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    exact binary_submodule_complement_card_eq B B' hB hdim
  have hdimcard : Fintype.card B' = 2 * Fintype.card B := by
    have hBcard : Fintype.card B = 2 ^ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B := by
      simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := B))
    have hB'card : Fintype.card B' = 2 ^ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' := by
      simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := B'))
    rw [hBcard, hB'card, hdim, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [htotal, houtside, hdimcard, hcomp]
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc]

/-- The quotient vector selected by a functional taking value one on `v` is
nonzero. This is the geometric input that supplies the translating
functional for the half-mass count. -/
theorem restrictedFunctional_quotient_vector_ne_zero
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  have hvK : (v : X) ∈ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hzero
  change (v : X) ∈ (LinearMap.ker phi).map A.subtype at hvK
  rcases Submodule.mem_map.mp hvK with ⟨a, ha, hax⟩
  have hae : a = v := Subtype.ext hax
  have hvzero : phi v = 0 := by
    rw [← hae]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ha
  rw [hv] at hvzero
  norm_num at hvzero

/-- The source-defined quotient column has the required half-mass outside
any codimension-one expanded codomain. The translating functional is
constructed from `phi v = 1`, rather than supplied as a sampling premise. -/
theorem restrictedFunctional_outsideColumn_card_half
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1) :
    Fintype.card ((X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') =
      2 * Fintype.card {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
        (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B} := by
  classical
  let qv := Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)
  have hqv := restrictedFunctional_quotient_vector_ne_zero A phi v hv
  have hnot : qv ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [qv] using hqv

  let hExt := LinearMap.exists_extend_of_notMem
    (0 : (⊥ : Submodule (ZMod 2) (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi)) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    hnot 1
  let ell := Classical.choose hExt
  have hell := (Classical.choose_spec hExt).2
  simpa only [qv] using
    (outsideColumn_card_half B B' hB hdim qv ell hell)

/-- For the actual restricted-functional quotient, conditioning on the
outside-column event costs at most two for every nonnegative real statistic.
The event-mass bound above is discharged from the binary codimension-one
geometry and the source condition `phi v = 1`. -/
theorem restrictedFunctional_outsideColumn_mean_le_two
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (g : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ N, 0 ≤ g N) :
    (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
      (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B),
      g N) /
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
        (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B)).card
      ≤ 2 * ((∑ N : X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B', g N) /
        (Fintype.card (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  let α := X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B'
  let p : α → Prop := fun N =>
    (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B
  have hprob : Fintype.card α ≤ 2 * (Finset.univ.filter p).card := by
    have hcard := restrictedFunctional_outsideColumn_card_half
      A phi v hv B B' hB hdim
    have hcard' : Fintype.card α =
        2 * Fintype.card {N : α // p N} := by
      simpa [α, p] using hcard
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype] at hcard'
    exact hcard'.le
  have hne : (Finset.univ.filter p).Nonempty := by
    have htotal : 0 < Fintype.card α := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨0⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (Finset.univ.filter p).card := by omega
    exact Finset.card_pos.mp hpos
  exact conditional_uniform_mean_le_two p hne hprob g hg

/-- Exact finite sum reindexing for the outside-column event, with the
column value kept as the dependent sigma index. -/
theorem outsideColumnSigma_sum
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B') (v : X)
    (g : {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} → ℝ) :
    (∑ F : {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B}, g F) =
      ∑ p : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
          {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // F v = w},
        g ((outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB v).symm p) := by
  classical
  exact (Equiv.sum_comp (outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB v).symm
    (fun F => g F)).symm

/-- Normalized outside-column averaging is exactly averaging first over the
column and then its map fiber. No branch-mass or energy hypothesis is used. -/
theorem outsideColumnSigma_mean
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B') (v : X)
    (g : {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} → ℝ) :
    (∑ F : {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B}, g F) /
        (Fintype.card {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // (F v : W) ∉ B} : ℝ) =
      (∑ p : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
          {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // F v = w},
        g ((outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB v).symm p)) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
          {F : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // F v = w}) : ℝ) := by
  rw [outsideColumnSigma_sum B B' hB v g,
    Fintype.card_congr (outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB v)]

/-- A fixed outside-column fiber in the actual codimension-one extension is
the quotient-section coordinate product. This is the fiberwise bridge used
to combine the sigma partition with the source's quotient-conditioned law. -/
noncomputable def actualOutsideColumnFiberCoordinates
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (w : B') (hw : (w : W) ∉ B)
    (hspan : spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) = B') :
    {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
      N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) = w} ≃
      ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) := by
  let eW : spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] B' :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan
  let wExt : spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) :=
    ⟨(w : W), Submodule.mem_sup_right
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (w : W)))⟩
  let eFixed := restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B
    (w : W) hw
  let qv : X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi :=
    Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)
  have hforced
      (N : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
        N qv = w}) :
      eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp N.1 qv = wExt := by
    change eW.symm (N.1 qv) = wExt
    rw [N.2]
    apply eW.injective
    rfl
  refine
    { toFun := fun N => eFixed ⟨eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp N.1, hforced N⟩
      invFun := fun p => ⟨eW.toLinearMap.comp (eFixed.symm p).1, ?_⟩
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · change eW ((eFixed.symm p).1 qv) = w
    rw [(eFixed.symm p).2]
    rfl
  · intro N
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hfixed := congrArg Subtype.val
      (eFixed.symm_apply_apply
        (⟨eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp N.1, hforced N⟩ :
          {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
            spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) // N qv = wExt}))
    change eW ((eFixed.symm
      (eFixed ⟨eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp N.1, hforced N⟩)).1 x) = N.1 x
    rw [hfixed]
    change eW (eW.symm (N.1 x)) = N.1 x
    exact eW.apply_symm_apply _
  · intro p
    let T := eFixed.symm p
    have hcancel : eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp (eW.toLinearMap.comp T.1) = T.1 := by
      ext x
      simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hsource :
        (⟨eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp (eW.toLinearMap.comp T.1), by
          change (eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp (eW.toLinearMap.comp T.1)) qv = wExt
          rw [hcancel]
          exact T.2⟩ :
          {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
            spanExtensionSubmodule B (w : W) // N qv = wExt}) = T := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hcancel
    calc
      eFixed ⟨eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp (eW.toLinearMap.comp T.1), by
        change (eW.symm.toLinearMap.comp (eW.toLinearMap.comp T.1)) qv = wExt
        rw [hcancel]
        exact T.2⟩ = eFixed T := congrArg eFixed hsource
      _ = p := eFixed.apply_symm_apply p

end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18SourceConditioning
end

/-!
The source-defined expanded A18 branch on the actual affine matrix fibre.
The restricted-functional outside-column event is measured using the actual
quotient-Hom representation of the affine fibre. The order drop is derived
from the kernel of the restricted functional and the one-dimensional
codomain extension; no conditional-energy or event-density premise is
introduced.
-/
namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18SourceGlobal

open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18Conditioning

private theorem andRec_projection
    {P Q : Prop} {α : Sort*} (hp : P ∧ Q) (f : P → Q → α) :
    And.rec f hp = f hp.1 hp.2 := by
  cases hp
  rfl

/-- The source globalness parameter is nonnegative, by the order-zero
whole-space restriction. This local fact avoids importing the unrelated
fixed-coordinate line-average bridge. -/
theorem actual_source_parameter_nonneg {n d r : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal r ε f) : 0 ≤ ε := by
  let Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := ⊥, codomainVariation := ⊤, base := 0 }
  have htop : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))) = 0 := by
    have h := (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2)).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    rw [finrank_top] at h
    omega
  have hQ : Q.order ≤ r := by
    dsimp [Q, ActualAffineRestriction.order]
    rw [finrank_bot, htop]
    omega
  have henergy : 0 ≤ fibreEnergy Q.fibre f := by
    unfold fibreEnergy
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun M _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg (f M)
    · exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
  exact le_trans henergy (hf Q hQ)

/-- The actual restricted-functional kernel loses one dimension. -/
theorem restrictedFunctionalKernel_finrank_drop
    {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) X]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A := by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective phi := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨y • v, ?_⟩
    simp [map_smul, hv]
  have hrange : LinearMap.range phi = ⊤ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj
  have hrank := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker phi
  rw [hrange] at hrank
  have hker : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker phi) + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A := by
    simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hrank
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((LinearMap.ker phi).map A.subtype) + 1 = _
  rw [Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
  exact hker

/-- Enlarging the binary codomain by one dimension lowers its quotient
codimension by one. -/
theorem codimension_drop_of_one_dim_extension
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W)
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (W ⧸ B') + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (W ⧸ B) := by
  have hB := B.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have hB' := B'.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  omega

/-- On the actual affine fibre with the functional-kernel domain and
one-dimensional expanded codomain, the source globalness hypothesis at
order `s+1` gives a conditional outside-column energy bound `2η`. The
statistic is the actual squared output of the matrix in the affine fibre,
transported through the accepted quotient-Hom equivalence. -/
theorem actual_expanded_outside_column_energy_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1) :
    (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
        (fun N =>
          (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi) (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
            Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation),
        Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv
          ({ domainFixed := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
             codomainVariation := B'
             base := Q.base })).symm N))) /
      ((Finset.univ : Finset
        ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
          (fun N =>
            (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi) (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
              Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation)).card
      ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
  have hAdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A' + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.domainFixed := by
    simpa [A'] using restrictedFunctionalKernel_finrank_drop
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  have hBcodim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ B') + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation) :=
    codimension_drop_of_one_dim_extension Q.codomainVariation B' hdim
  have hQorder :
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.domainFixed +
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
          ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation) ≤ s + 1 := by
    simpa [ActualAffineRestriction.order] using hQ
  have horderdrop : Q'.order + 2 = Q.order := by
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A' +
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ B') + 2 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.domainFixed +
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation)
    rw [← hAdim, ← hBcodim]
    omega
  have hsmall : Q'.order ≤ s - 1 := by
    have hsmall' : Q'.order + 2 ≤ s + 1 := by
      rw [horderdrop]
      exact hQ
    omega
  let e := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q'
  let g : (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') → ℝ :=
    fun N => Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))
  have hg : ∀ N, 0 ≤ g N := fun N => Complex.normSq_nonneg _
  have hconditional := restrictedFunctional_outsideColumn_mean_le_two
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim g hg
  have hglobalSmall : fibreEnergy Q'.fibre f ≤ η := hf Q' (by omega)
  have henergy :
      (∑ N : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B', g N) /
        (Fintype.card (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') : ℝ) ≤ η := by
    rw [← actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_energy Q' f]
    exact hglobalSmall
  have hconditional' :
      (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset
        (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
          (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
            Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation), g N) /
        ((Finset.univ : Finset
          (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
            (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
              Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation)).card ≤
      2 * ((∑ N : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B', g N) /
        (Fintype.card (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [A', g, e] using hconditional
  calc
    _ = (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset
        (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
          (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
            Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation), g N) /
        ((Finset.univ : Finset
          (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter
            (fun N => (N (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
              Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation)).card := by
          rfl
    _ ≤ 2 * ((∑ N : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B', g N) /
          (Fintype.card (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') : ℝ)) :=
      hconditional'
    _ ≤ 2 * η :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henergy (by norm_num)

/-- Codomain-valued stable sample map in quotient-section coordinates. -/
noncomputable def stableSourceSampleMap
    {X X' W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module (ZMod 2) X']
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X)
    (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (R : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (w : B) :
    X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B := by
  let F := quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W)
  exact F.codRestrict B (fun x => by
    have hx : F x ∈ LinearMap.range F := ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact quotientSampleOutput_range_stable B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W)
      w.property hx)

/-- The complete stable source draw `(w,R,lambda)` pushes forward uniformly
to the actual map on the larger quotient, with an independent uniform
functional coordinate left over. In particular this includes every `w`
(including zero), rather than conditioning on a fixed column. -/
noncomputable def stableSourceCoordinatesEquiv
    {X X' W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module (ZMod 2) X']
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X) (s : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] X')
    (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (v : X')
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hqv : q v = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1)
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) :
    (Σ w : B, (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) ≃
      (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) where
  toFun p :=
    (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1, p.2.2)
  invFun p :=
    ⟨p.1 v, (p.1.comp s - p.2.smulRight (p.1 v), p.2)⟩
  left_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨w, coords⟩
    rcases coords with ⟨R, lambda⟩
    have hcol : stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ R lambda w v = w := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) v = (w : W)
      exact quotientSampleOutput_newColumn B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) v hqv hphiV
    apply Sigma.ext hcol
    · apply heq_of_eq
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hsection :
            (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ R lambda w).comp s =
              R + lambda.smulRight w := by
          ext y
          change quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) (s y) =
            (R y : W) + lambda y • (w : W)
          exact quotientSampleOutput_section B q s phi₀ R lambda
            (w : W) hqs hphiS y
        change (((stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ R lambda w).comp s) x -
          lambda x • (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ R lambda w v : W)) =
            (R x : W)
        rw [hsection, hcol]
        change ((R x : W) + lambda x • (w : W) -
          lambda x • (w : W)) = (R x : W)
        simp [sub_eq_add_neg,
          add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
      · rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hdecompN : p.1 x = p.1 (s (q x)) + phi₀ x • p.1 v := by
        have h := congrArg p.1 (hdecomp x)
        simpa using h
      change quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀
        (p.1.comp s - p.2.smulRight (p.1 v)) p.2 (p.1 v) x = p.1 x
      simp only [quotientSampleOutput, LinearMap.add_apply,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply]
      rw [hdecompN]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_smul, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm]
    · rfl

/-- An independent finite coordinate does not change a normalized uniform
mean of a statistic that ignores that coordinate. -/
theorem uniformMean_product_fst
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : α × β, g p.1) / (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℝ) =
      (∑ a : α, g a) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
  have hsum : (∑ p : α × β, g p.1) =
      (Fintype.card β : ℝ) * (∑ a : α, g a) := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℝ) =
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ) * (Fintype.card β : ℝ) := by simp
  have hβ : (Fintype.card β : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_ne_zero : Fintype.card β ≠ 0)
  rw [hsum, hcard]
  field_simp

/-- The full stable source draw has exactly the uniform normalized mean on
the quotient maps; the independent functional coordinate cancels from the
normalization. This averages over the source column `w` as well as both
linear-map coordinates. -/
theorem stableSource_uniformMean_eq
    {X X' W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module (ZMod 2) X']
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype X'] [Fintype W]
    (q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X) (s : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] X')
    (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (v : X')
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • v)
    (hqs : q.comp s = LinearMap.id) (hqv : q v = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp s = 0) (hphiV : phi₀ v = 1)
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W)
    (g : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : Σ w : B, (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
      g (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : B,
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) =
      (∑ N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B, g N) /
        (Fintype.card (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let e := stableSourceCoordinatesEquiv q s phi₀ v hdecomp hqs hqv
    hphiS hphiV B
  have hsum :
      (∑ p : Σ w : B, (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        g (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)) =
      ∑ z : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2), g z.1 := by
    calc
      (∑ p : Σ w : B, (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
          g (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)) =
        ∑ p : Σ w : B, (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2), g (e p).1 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro p hp
            rfl
      _ = ∑ z : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2), g z.1 :=
            Equiv.sum_comp e (fun z : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
              (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) => g z.1)
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card (Σ w : B,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) =
      Fintype.card ((X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) ×
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) := Fintype.card_congr e
  rw [hsum, hcard]
  exact uniformMean_product_fst g

/-- The complete stable source draw on an actual restricted-functional
quotient is bounded by the original globalness hypothesis. The section
coordinates are obtained from the source functional itself; the target mean
is the normalized energy of an actual affine matrix fibre with one less
order. -/
theorem actual_stable_source_energy_le
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
      { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
        base := Q.base }
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
    let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    ∃ sCoord : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] X',
      ∃ phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2,
        q.comp sCoord = LinearMap.id ∧
        q (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) = 0 ∧
        phi₀.comp sCoord = 0 ∧
        phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ x, x = sCoord (q x) + phi₀ x •
          Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) ∧
        (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
            (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
              (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
            Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm
              (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀
                p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)))) /
          (Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
            (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
              (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ η := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
      base := Q.base }
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  rcases quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv with
    ⟨sCoord, phi₀, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp⟩
  let e := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q'
  let g : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) → ℝ :=
    fun N => Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))
  have hAdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A' + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.domainFixed := by
    simpa [A'] using restrictedFunctionalKernel_finrank_drop
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  have horder : Q'.order ≤ s := by
    dsimp [Q', ActualAffineRestriction.order]
    dsimp [ActualAffineRestriction.order] at hQ
    omega
  have hmean := stableSource_uniformMean_eq
    q sCoord phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2))
    hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV Q.codomainVariation g
  have henergy :
      (∑ N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation, g N) /
        (Fintype.card (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) : ℝ) ≤ η := by
    rw [← actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_energy Q' f]
    exact hf Q' horder
  refine ⟨sCoord, phi₀, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, ?_⟩
  change
    (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        g (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀
          p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ η
  rw [hmean]
  exact henergy

/-- Stable source energy for a specified section coordinate system. This lets
the zero quotient-coset estimate use the same source coordinates as every
one-dimensional expanded coset. -/
theorem actual_stable_source_energy_le_of_coordinates
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (sCoord : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi))
    (phi₀ : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (hqs : (Submodule.factor
      (p := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
      (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)).comp sCoord = LinearMap.id)
    (hqv : Submodule.factor
      (p := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
      (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
      (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi) (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) = 0)
    (hphiS : phi₀.comp sCoord = 0)
    (hphiV : phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
      (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) = 1)
    (hdecomp : ∀ x, x = sCoord
      (Submodule.factor (p := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
        (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
          intro y hy
          rcases hy with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
          exact a.property) x) +
      phi₀ x • Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
        (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
      { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
        base := Q.base }
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
    let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm
          (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)))) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ η := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
      base := Q.base }
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let e := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q'
  let g : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) → ℝ :=
    fun N => Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))
  have hAdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A' + 1 =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.domainFixed := by
    simpa [A'] using restrictedFunctionalKernel_finrank_drop
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  have horder : Q'.order ≤ s := by
    dsimp [Q', ActualAffineRestriction.order]
    dsimp [ActualAffineRestriction.order] at hQ
    omega
  have hmean := stableSource_uniformMean_eq
    q sCoord phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2))
    hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV Q.codomainVariation g
  have henergy :
      (∑ N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation, g N) /
        (Fintype.card (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) : ℝ) ≤ η := by
    rw [← actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_energy Q' f]
    exact hf Q' horder
  change
    (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        g (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation,
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) × (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ η
  rw [hmean]
  exact henergy

/-- For a fixed codimension-one codomain extension, the complete source draw
over all outside columns and quotient-coordinate pairs is equivalent to the
actual quotient maps conditioned on their distinguished column lying outside
the old codomain. The per-column equivalences are derived from the actual
restricted-functional fibre map and the span equality for every outside
column. -/
noncomputable def actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1) :
    (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
      ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) ≃
    {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
      (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B} := by
  classical
  let qv : X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi :=
    Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)
  let Wout := {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}
  let Fiber (w : Wout) :=
    {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
      N qv = w.1}
  let coordinates (w : Wout) : Fiber w ≃
      ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) :=
    actualOutsideColumnFiberCoordinates A phi v hv B B' w.1 w.2
      (spanExtension_eq_of_codim_one B B' hB hdim w.1 w.2)
  let fibers :
      (Σ w : Wout,
        ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) ≃
      Σ w : Wout, Fiber w :=
    Equiv.sigmaCongrRight (fun w => (coordinates w).symm)
  exact fibers.trans (outsideColumnSigmaEquiv B B' hB qv).symm

/-- After forgetting the codomain subtype, the expanded source-coordinate
map is precisely the affine quotient sample. This is the pointwise bridge
from the finite source draw to the matrix statistic used by A18. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_coordinates_coe
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
    let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A) :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    ∃ phi₀ : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2,
      ∃ s : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A'),
      q.comp s = LinearMap.id ∧
      q (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 0 ∧
      phi₀.comp s = 0 ∧
      phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 1 ∧
      (∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) ∧
      ∀ (w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B})
        (R : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B)
        (lambda : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        B'.subtype.comp
          (((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv A phi v hv B B' hB hdim)
            ⟨w, (R, lambda)⟩).1) =
          quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  have hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv
  let s := Classical.choose hsource
  have hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  let hparts := Classical.choose_spec hphiSource
  have hpartsEq : hparts =
      ⟨hparts.1, hparts.2.1, hparts.2.2.1,
        hparts.2.2.2.1, hparts.2.2.2.2⟩ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let hqs := hparts.1
  let hqv := hparts.2.1
  let hphiS := hparts.2.2.1
  let hphiV := hparts.2.2.2.1
  let hdecomp := hparts.2.2.2.2
  refine ⟨phi₀, s, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, ?_⟩
  intro w R lambda
  let wW : W := w.1
  have hspan : spanExtensionSubmodule B wW = B' :=
    spanExtension_eq_of_codim_one B B' hB hdim w.1 w.2
  let eW : spanExtensionSubmodule B wW ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] B' :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan
  let eFixed := restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B wW w.2
  let eFiber := actualOutsideColumnFiberCoordinates A phi v hv B B'
    w.1 w.2 hspan
  let N := eFiber.symm (R, lambda)
  have happended :
      (spanExtensionSubmodule B wW).subtype.comp
          ((restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B wW w.2).symm
            (R, lambda)).1 =
        quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda wW := by
    simpa only [restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv, andRec_projection] using
      (quotientAppendSamplingEquiv_symm_apply B wW w.2 q s phi₀
        (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV R lambda)
  have hNmap : N.1 = eW.toLinearMap.comp (eFixed.symm (R, lambda)).1 := by
    rfl
  have hcoerce : B'.subtype.comp eW.toLinearMap =
      (spanExtensionSubmodule B wW).subtype := by
    ext z
    rfl
  dsimp [actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv]
  change B'.subtype.comp N.1 = quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda wW
  rw [hNmap, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hcoerce]
  exact happended

/-! The section and independent functional above are chosen from `A`, `phi`,
and `v` only. This strengthened form fixes them before choosing the
one-dimensional codomain extension, so quotient-coset fibers share one
source coordinate system. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_coordinates_coe_uniform
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
    let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A) :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv
    let s := Classical.choose hsource
    let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
    let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
    q.comp s = LinearMap.id ∧
        q (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 0 ∧
        phi₀.comp s = 0 ∧
        phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ x, x = s (q x) + phi₀ x • Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) ∧
        ∀ (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
          (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
            Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
          (w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B})
          (R : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B)
          (lambda : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
          B'.subtype.comp
              (((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv A phi v hv
                B B' hB hdim) ⟨w, (R, lambda)⟩).1) =
            quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  have hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv
  let s := Classical.choose hsource
  have hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  let hparts := Classical.choose_spec hphiSource
  have hpartsEq : hparts =
      ⟨hparts.1, hparts.2.1, hparts.2.2.1,
        hparts.2.2.2.1, hparts.2.2.2.2⟩ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let hqs := hparts.1
  let hqv := hparts.2.1
  let hphiS := hparts.2.2.1
  let hphiV := hparts.2.2.2.1
  let hdecomp := hparts.2.2.2.2
  refine ⟨hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, ?_⟩
  intro B' hB hdim w R lambda
  let wW : W := w.1
  have hspan : spanExtensionSubmodule B wW = B' :=
    spanExtension_eq_of_codim_one B B' hB hdim w.1 w.2
  let eW : spanExtensionSubmodule B wW ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] B' :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hspan
  let eFixed := restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B wW w.2
  let eFiber := actualOutsideColumnFiberCoordinates A phi v hv B B'
    w.1 w.2 hspan
  let N := eFiber.symm (R, lambda)
  have happended :
      (spanExtensionSubmodule B wW).subtype.comp
          ((restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv A phi v hv B wW w.2).symm
            (R, lambda)).1 =
        quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda wW := by
    simpa only [restrictedFunctionalAppendSamplingEquiv, andRec_projection] using
      (quotientAppendSamplingEquiv_symm_apply B wW w.2 q s phi₀
        (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) hdecomp hqs hqv hphiS hphiV R lambda)
  have hNmap : N.1 = eW.toLinearMap.comp (eFixed.symm (R, lambda)).1 := by
    rfl
  have hcoerce : B'.subtype.comp eW.toLinearMap =
      (spanExtensionSubmodule B wW).subtype := by
    ext z
    rfl
  dsimp [actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv]
  change B'.subtype.comp N.1 =
    quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda wW
  rw [hNmap, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hcoerce]
  exact happended

/-- Exact normalized-mean reindexing for the expanded source draw over all
outside columns. This is the finite law needed before applying the actual
outside-column energy estimate. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_mean_eq_conditional
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) X) (phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (g : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
      (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B} → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
        ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        g ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv
          A phi v hv B B' hB hdim) p)) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B},
        ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) × ((X ⧸ A) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) =
    (∑ N : {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
        (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B},
        g N) /
      (Fintype.card {N : (X ⧸ functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' //
        (N (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi) (v : X)) : W) ∉ B} : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let e := actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv
    A phi v hv B B' hB hdim
  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp e g
