  have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
  rw [hsum, hcard]

/-- Convert the outside-map subtype mean to the corresponding filtered
finite mean without unfolding the dependent map predicate. -/
theorem outsideMap_subtype_mean_eq_filter
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (g : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ x : {x : α // p x}, g x.1) / (Fintype.card {x : α // p x} : ℝ) =
    (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter p, g x) /
      ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter p).card := by
  classical
  have hsum : (∑ x : {x : α // p x}, g x) =
      ∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter p, g x := by
    simpa only [Finset.subtype_univ] using
      (Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (p := p) g)
  have hcard : Fintype.card {x : α // p x} =
      ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter p).card := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_subtype]
  rw [hsum, hcard]

/-- The expanded source draw over all outside columns has normalized squared
energy at most `2η`. The outside-column coordinates are reindexed to the
actual quotient maps, and the factor two is discharged by the proved
half-mass event together with the globalness bound on the lower-order actual
restriction. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_energy_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    (∑ p : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation},
        ((X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)),
        Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv
          ({ domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base })).symm
          (actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
            Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim p)))) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : B' //
        (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation},
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
            (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
  let e := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q'
  let p : (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B') → Prop := fun N =>
    (N (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)) : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉
      Q.codomainVariation
  let g : {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N} → ℝ :=
    fun N => Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N.1))
  have hcond := actual_expanded_outside_column_energy_le_two
    f hf Q hQ phi v hv B' hB hdim
  have hfilter :
      (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter p,
        Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))) /
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter p).card ≤
      2 * η := by
    simpa [A', X', Q', e, p] using hcond
  have hsubtype :
      (∑ N : {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N}, g N) /
      (Fintype.card {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N} : ℝ) ≤
      2 * η := by
    change
      (∑ N : {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N},
        Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))) /
        (Fintype.card {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N} : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η
    calc
      (∑ N : {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N},
          Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))) /
          (Fintype.card {N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' // p N} : ℝ) =
        (∑ N ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter p,
          Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N))) /
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B')).filter p).card :=
        outsideMap_subtype_mean_eq_filter p
          (fun N : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] B' => Complex.normSq (f (e.symm N)))
      _ ≤ 2 * η := hfilter
  have hsource := actual_expanded_source_mean_eq_conditional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim g
  change
    (∑ p₀ : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉
        Q.codomainVariation},
        ((X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)),
        g ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv
          Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim) p₀)) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉
        Q.codomainVariation},
          (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
            (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η
  rw [hsource]
  exact hsubtype

/-- Combine the stable and outside-column source draws over a binary
codimension-one extension. The two source populations have equal size by
the geometric complement count, so their mixture is the arithmetic mean of
the stable and conditioned-expanded energies. -/
theorem stable_expanded_source_mixture_le_two
    {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype X] [Fintype W]
    (B B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (hB : B ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (C : Type*) [Fintype C] [Nonempty C]
    (gStable : (Σ w : B, C) → ℝ)
    (gExpanded : (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}, C) → ℝ)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hStable : (∑ p : Σ w : B, C, gStable p) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : B, C) : ℝ) ≤ η)
    (hExpanded : (∑ p : Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}, C, gExpanded p) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}, C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η) :
    (∑ p : Sum (Σ w : B, C) (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}, C),
        Sum.elim gStable gExpanded p) /
      (Fintype.card (Sum (Σ w : B, C)
        (Σ w : {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}, C)) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let O := {w : B' // (w : W) ∉ B}
  let S := Σ w : B, C
  let E := Σ w : O, C
  have hO : Fintype.card O = Fintype.card B := by
    dsimp [O]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    exact binary_submodule_complement_card_eq B B' hB hdim
  have hSC : Fintype.card S = Fintype.card B * Fintype.card C := by
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp
  have hEC : Fintype.card E = Fintype.card O * Fintype.card C := by
    dsimp [E]
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp
  have hpop : Fintype.card S = Fintype.card E := by
    rw [hSC, hEC, hO]
  have hSpos : 0 < (Fintype.card S : ℝ) := by
    apply Nat.cast_pos.mpr
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨⟨0, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty C›⟩⟩
  have hsum :
      (∑ p : Sum S E, Sum.elim gStable gExpanded p) =
        (∑ p : S, gStable p) + (∑ p : E, gExpanded p) := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
  have hcard :
      (Fintype.card (Sum S E) : ℝ) = 2 * (Fintype.card S : ℝ) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_sum]
    push_cast
    rw [hpop.symm]
    ring
  have hmean :
      ((∑ p : Sum S E, Sum.elim gStable gExpanded p) /
        (Fintype.card (Sum S E) : ℝ)) =
      (((∑ p : S, gStable p) / (Fintype.card S : ℝ)) +
        ((∑ p : E, gExpanded p) / (Fintype.card E : ℝ))) / 2 := by
    rw [hsum, hcard, hpop.symm]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hSpos]
  change ((∑ p : Sum S E, Sum.elim gStable gExpanded p) /
      (Fintype.card (Sum S E) : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * η
  rw [hmean]
  have hsumBound :
      (∑ p : S, gStable p) / (Fintype.card S : ℝ) +
        (∑ p : E, gExpanded p) / (Fintype.card E : ℝ) ≤ η + 2 * η :=
    add_le_add hStable hExpanded
  calc
    _ ≤ (η + 2 * η) / 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsumBound (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 2 * η := by nlinarith

/-- The source-actual stable/expanded mixture itself has energy at most
`2η`. The stable coordinates use the actual fibre with the restricted
functional kernel and old codomain; the expanded coordinates use the same
kernel and the one-dimensional codomain extension. Their population sizes
are equal by the binary outside-column count, so this is the full two-branch
source mean, not an assumed conditional weighting. -/
theorem actual_A18_source_branch_mixture_energy_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X0 := Fin d → ZMod 2
    let X := X0 ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let X' := X0 ⧸ A'
    let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    ∃ sCoord : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] X',
      ∃ phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2,
      q.comp sCoord = LinearMap.id ∧
      q (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X0)) = 0 ∧
      phi₀.comp sCoord = 0 ∧
      phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X0)) = 1 ∧
      (∀ x, x = sCoord (q x) + phi₀ x • Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X0)) ∧
      let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
        (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
      let Stable := Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C
      let Outside := {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation}
      let Expanded := Σ w : Outside, C
      let QStable : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
        { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
          base := Q.base }
      let QExpanded : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
        { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
      (∑ p : Sum Stable Expanded,
        Sum.elim
          (fun p => Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv
            QStable).symm (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q
              phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)).1))
          (fun p => Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv
            QExpanded).symm ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv
              Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim p).1)).1)) p) /
        (Fintype.card (Sum Stable Expanded) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨sCoord, phi₀, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, hstable⟩ :=
    actual_stable_source_energy_le f hf Q hQ phi v hv
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X0 := Fin d → ZMod 2
  let X := X0 ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := X0 ⧸ A'
  let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let C : Type := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
    (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
  let Stable := Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C
  let Outside := {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation}
  let Expanded := Σ w : Outside, C
  let QStable : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
      base := Q.base }
  let QExpanded : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
  let gStable : Stable → ℝ := fun p => Complex.normSq (f
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv QStable).symm
      (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀
        p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)).1)
  let gExpanded : Expanded → ℝ := fun p => Complex.normSq (f
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv QExpanded).symm
      ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
        Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim p).1)).1)
  have hstable' : (∑ p : Stable, gStable p) /
      (Fintype.card Stable : ℝ) ≤ η := by
    simpa [A', X, X', q, C, Stable, QStable, gStable] using hstable
  have hexpanded := actual_expanded_source_energy_le_two
    f hf Q hQ phi v hv B' hB hdim
  have hexpanded' : (∑ p : Expanded, gExpanded p) /
      (Fintype.card Expanded : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
    simpa [A', X, X', q, C, Outside, Expanded, QExpanded, gExpanded] using
      hexpanded
  have hη : 0 ≤ η := actual_source_parameter_nonneg f hf
  have hmixed := stable_expanded_source_mixture_le_two
    Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim (X := X) (C := C) gStable gExpanded hη hstable' hexpanded'
  refine ⟨sCoord, phi₀, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, ?_⟩
  simpa [A', X0, X, X', q, C, Stable, Outside, Expanded,
    QStable, QExpanded, gStable, gExpanded] using hmixed

/-- The ambient column set is the dependent sum of quotient cosets modulo
`B`. This is the exact grouping that assigns each outside column to its
unique one-dimensional extension `B ⊔ span{w}`. -/
noncomputable def quotientCosetColumnEquiv
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) :
    (Σ q : W ⧸ B, {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q}) ≃ W where
  toFun p := p.2.1
  invFun w := ⟨Submodule.mkQ B w, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩
  left_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨q, w, hw⟩
    cases hw
    rfl
  right_inv w := rfl

/-- Every quotient coset has exactly the cardinality of `B`; the chosen
representative only translates the coset and does not change its size. -/
noncomputable def quotientCosetFibreEquiv
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (q : W ⧸ B) :
    {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} ≃ B := by
  classical
  let w₀ := Classical.choose (Submodule.mkQ_surjective B q)
  have hw₀ : Submodule.mkQ B w₀ = q :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Submodule.mkQ_surjective B q)
  refine
    { toFun := fun w => ⟨w.1 - w₀, ?_⟩
      invFun := fun b => ⟨(b : W) + w₀, ?_⟩
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · have hz : Submodule.mkQ B (w.1 - w₀) = 0 := by
      simp [map_sub, w.2, hw₀]
    have hk : w.1 - w₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) :=
      LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hz
    rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ] at hk
    exact hk
  · have hbker : (b : W) ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) := by
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
      exact b.property
    have hbzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hbker
    simp [map_add, hbzero, hw₀]
  · intro w
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  · intro b
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp

/-- Cardinality form of the quotient-coset translation equivalence. -/
theorem quotientCosetFibre_card
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (q : W ⧸ B) :
    Fintype.card {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} = Fintype.card B :=
  Fintype.card_congr (quotientCosetFibreEquiv B q)

/-- Quotient-coset partition of an ambient column paired with any independent
finite coordinate. This is the finite reindexing used to group all columns
by their actual extension of `B`. -/
noncomputable def quotientCosetColumnProductEquiv
    {W C : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) :
    (Σ q : W ⧸ B, {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} × C) ≃ W × C where
  toFun p := (p.2.1.1, p.2.2)
  invFun z := ⟨Submodule.mkQ B z.1, (⟨z.1, rfl⟩, z.2)⟩
  left_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨q, w, c⟩
    rcases w with ⟨w, hw⟩
    cases hw
    rfl
  right_inv z := rfl

/-- Exact finite-sum reindexing by quotient cosets. -/
theorem quotientCosetColumnProduct_sum
    {W C : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype W] [Fintype C]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (g : W × C → ℝ) :
    (∑ p : Σ q : W ⧸ B, {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} × C,
      g (p.2.1.1, p.2.2)) = ∑ z : W × C, g z := by
  let e := quotientCosetColumnProductEquiv (C := C) B
  change (∑ p, g (e p)) = ∑ z, g z
  exact Equiv.sum_comp e g

/-- If every quotient-coset conditional mean of a nonnegative statistic is
at most `2η`, then so is its ambient-column mean. The proof uses the exact
quotient-coset partition and the translation equivalence showing all fibers
have equal size. -/
theorem quotientCoset_partition_mean_le_two
    {W C : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    [Fintype W] [Fintype C] [Nonempty C]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (g : W × C → ℝ) {η : ℝ}
    (hfiber : ∀ q : W ⧸ B,
      (∑ z : {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} × C, g (z.1.1, z.2)) /
        (Fintype.card ({w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} × C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η) :
    (∑ z : W × C, g z) / (Fintype.card (W × C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let Fiber (q : W ⧸ B) := {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = q} × C
  let SigmaFiber := Σ q : W ⧸ B, Fiber q
  let gFiber : SigmaFiber → ℝ := fun p => g (p.2.1.1, p.2.2)
  have hcard : Fintype.card SigmaFiber = Fintype.card (W × C) :=
    Fintype.card_congr (quotientCosetColumnProductEquiv B)
  have hsumFiber : (∑ p : SigmaFiber, gFiber p) =
      ∑ q : W ⧸ B, ∑ z : Fiber q, g (z.1.1, z.2) := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  have hgroup_pos (q : W ⧸ B) : 0 < (Fintype.card (Fiber q) : ℝ) := by
    apply Nat.cast_pos.mpr
    apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
    let w₀ := Classical.choose (Submodule.mkQ_surjective B q)
    have hw₀ : Submodule.mkQ B w₀ = q :=
      Classical.choose_spec (Submodule.mkQ_surjective B q)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨w₀, hw₀⟩, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty C›⟩⟩
  have hgroup_sum (q : W ⧸ B) :
      (∑ z : Fiber q, g (z.1.1, z.2)) ≤
        (2 * η) * (Fintype.card (Fiber q) : ℝ) :=
    (div_le_iff₀ (hgroup_pos q)).mp (by simpa [Fiber] using hfiber q)
  have hsum_bound : (∑ p : SigmaFiber, gFiber p) ≤
      (2 * η) * (Fintype.card SigmaFiber : ℝ) := by
    rw [hsumFiber]
    calc
      (∑ q : W ⧸ B, ∑ z : Fiber q, g (z.1.1, z.2)) ≤
          ∑ q : W ⧸ B,
            (2 * η) * (Fintype.card (Fiber q) : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q hq => hgroup_sum q)
      _ = (2 * η) * (Fintype.card SigmaFiber : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        congr 1
        rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
        push_cast
        rfl
  have hpos : 0 < (Fintype.card (W × C) : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨(0, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty C›)⟩)
  rw [← quotientCosetColumnProduct_sum B g, ← hcard]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by simpa [hcard] using hpos)).mpr
  change (∑ p : SigmaFiber, gFiber p) ≤
    (2 * η) * (Fintype.card SigmaFiber : ℝ)
  exact hsum_bound

/-- The accepted actual fibre quotient equivalence uses the manuscript's
affine matrix formula: base plus the matrix of the quotient map lifted into
the codomain variation subspace. -/
theorem actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_symm_matrix
    {n d : ℕ} (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (N : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation) :
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm N).1 =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
            (N.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ)) := by
  simp [actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv, actualFibreLinearEquiv,
    quotientHomEquiv, ConstrainedMap, LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin',
    Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
  rw [add_comm]

/-- Coercion of the stable codomain-valued source map is exactly the
unconstrained `W`-valued quotient sample. -/
theorem stableSourceSampleMap_coe
    {X X' W : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module (ZMod 2) X]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module (ZMod 2) X']
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X)
    (phi₀ : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (R : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) (lambda : X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (w : B) :
    B.subtype.comp (stableSourceSampleMap B q phi₀ R lambda w) =
      quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda (w : W) := by
  ext x
  rfl

/-- Matrix form of the stable source sample in the actual affine-fibre
representation, with all quotient maps kept at their ambient dimensions. -/
theorem actual_stable_source_matrix_formula
    {n d : ℕ} (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (phi₀ : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸
        functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (R : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      Q.codomainVariation)
    (lambda : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (w : Q.codomainVariation) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
    let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
      { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
        base := Q.base }
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm
      (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda w)).1 =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
            (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
      base := Q.base }
  let N := stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda w
  have hco := stableSourceSampleMap_coe Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda w
  have hcomp : Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
        (N.comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) =
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
        (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A') := by
    exact congrArg
      (fun F : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) =>
        F.comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) hco
  calc
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm N).1 =
        LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp (N.comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))) :=
      actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_symm_matrix Q' N
    _ = LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
        (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
          (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) := by
      exact congrArg (fun F => LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + F)) hcomp
/-- Pointwise matrix form of the expanded source bridge. It identifies the
actual affine-fibre matrix with the manuscript sample `base + quotientSample`
for the same outside column and the same source coordinates. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_matrix_formula
    {n d : ℕ} (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
      { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
    let X := Fin d → ZMod 2
    let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ Q.domainFixed) :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    ∃ phi₀ : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2,
      ∃ sCoord : (X ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ A'),
      q.comp sCoord = LinearMap.id ∧
      q (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 0 ∧
      phi₀.comp sCoord = 0 ∧
      phi₀ (Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) = 1 ∧
      (∀ x, x = sCoord (q x) + phi₀ x • Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X)) ∧
      ∀ (w : {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation})
        (R : (X ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation)
        (lambda : (X ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
        ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm
          ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
            Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim ⟨w, (R, lambda)⟩).1)).1 =
        LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
            (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
              (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
  let X := Fin d → ZMod 2
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] (X ⧸ Q.domainFixed) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  obtain ⟨phi₀, sCoord, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, hcoerce⟩ :=
    actual_expanded_source_coordinates_coe Q.domainFixed phi v hv
      Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim
  refine ⟨phi₀, sCoord, hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, ?_⟩
  intro w R lambda
  let N := (actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
    Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim ⟨w, (R, lambda)⟩).1
  have hsample := hcoerce w R lambda
  have hcomp : B'.subtype.comp (N.comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) =
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
        (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A') := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hx := congrArg (fun F => F (Submodule.mkQ A' x)) hsample
    simpa [N, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx
  calc
    ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm N).1 =
        LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + B'.subtype.comp
            (N.comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))) :=
      actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_symm_matrix Q' N
    _ = LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀ R lambda
            (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) := by
      rw [hcomp]



/-- A nonzero quotient coset of `B` is exactly the outside-column set in
its one-dimensional extension by any chosen representative. This identifies
the dependent quotient partition with the actual expanded codomain fibre. -/
noncomputable def quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (w₀ : W) (hw₀ : w₀ ∉ B) :
    {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = Submodule.mkQ B w₀} ≃
      {u : spanExtensionSubmodule B w₀ // (u : W) ∉ B} := by
  classical
  refine
    { toFun := fun w => ⟨⟨w.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      invFun := fun u => ⟨u.1, ?_⟩
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · have hzero : Submodule.mkQ B (w.1 - w₀) = 0 := by
      simp [map_sub, w.2]
    have hker : w.1 - w₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) :=
      LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hzero
    rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ] at hker
    apply Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
    refine ⟨w.1 - w₀, hker, w₀,
      Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton w₀), ?_⟩
    abel
  · intro hB
    have hkerw : w.1 ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) := by
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
      exact hB
    have hqzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hkerw
    rw [w.2] at hqzero
    have hker₀ : w₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) :=
      LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hqzero
    rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ] at hker₀
    exact hw₀ hker₀
  · rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp u.1.property with ⟨b, hb, c, hc, hbc⟩
    rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hc with ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hu : (u.1 : W) = b + a • w₀ := by
      calc
        (u.1 : W) = b + c := hbc.symm
        _ = b + a • w₀ := by rw [ha]
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      apply u.2
      rw [hu, ha0, zero_smul]
      exact B.add_mem hb (B.zero_mem)
    have ha1 : a = 1 := by
      fin_cases a
      · exact False.elim (ha0 rfl)
      · rfl
    have hbker : b ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ B) := by
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
      exact hb
    have hbq := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hbker
    calc
      Submodule.mkQ B (u.1 : W) = Submodule.mkQ B (b + a • w₀) :=
        congrArg (Submodule.mkQ B) hu
      _ = Submodule.mkQ B w₀ := by
        simp [map_add, map_smul, ha1, hbq]
  · intro w
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  · intro u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

/-- The quotient-coset equivalence also transports the complete source tuple,
with all independent quotient-map coordinates unchanged. -/
noncomputable def quotientCosetSourceFibreEquiv
    {W C : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (w₀ : W) (hw₀ : w₀ ∉ B) :
    (Σ w : {w : W // Submodule.mkQ B w = Submodule.mkQ B w₀}, C) ≃
      (Σ u : {u : spanExtensionSubmodule B w₀ // (u : W) ∉ B}, C) where
  toFun p := ⟨quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension B w₀ hw₀ p.1, p.2⟩
  invFun p := ⟨(quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension B w₀ hw₀).symm p.1, p.2⟩
  left_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨w, c⟩
    apply Sigma.ext
    · exact (quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension B w₀ hw₀).symm_apply_apply w
    · rfl
  right_inv p := by
    rcases p with ⟨u, c⟩
    apply Sigma.ext
    · exact (quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension B w₀ hw₀).apply_symm_apply u
    · rfl
/-- The expanded outside-column energy bound in the common, source-chosen
quotient coordinates. The coordinate witness is fixed before `B'`, and the
actual quotient-fibre matrix is identified pointwise with the same affine
matrix statistic. -/
theorem actual_expanded_source_energy_le_two_common_coordinates
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (B' : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B')
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1) :
    let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
    let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
    let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
    let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let q : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
      (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    let Outside := {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation}
    (∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C,
      Complex.normSq (f (LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀
            p.2.1 p.2.2 (p.1 : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))))) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : Outside, C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
  let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let q : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
    (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
  let Outside := {w : B' // (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation}
  let Q' : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := B', base := Q.base }
  have hcoords := actual_expanded_source_coordinates_coe_uniform
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation
  rcases hcoords with ⟨hqs', hqv', hphiS', hphiV', hdecomp', hmatrix⟩
  have hbound := actual_expanded_source_energy_le_two
    f hf Q hQ phi v hv B' hB hdim
  have hsum :
      (∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C,
        Complex.normSq (f (LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
            (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q
              phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 (p.1 : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp
              (Submodule.mkQ A'))))) =
      ∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C,
        Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q').symm
          ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
            Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim p).1)).1) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    have hpoint := hmatrix B' hB hdim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
    have hmat := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_symm_matrix Q'
      ((actual_expanded_source_coordinates_equiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv
        Q.codomainVariation B' hB hdim p).1)
    have hcomp := congrArg (fun F => F.comp (Submodule.mkQ A')) hpoint
    apply congrArg (fun M => Complex.normSq (f M))
    rw [hmat]
    exact congrArg
      (fun F => LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + F))
      (by simpa [LinearMap.comp_assoc, Q', A', q, phi₀] using hcomp.symm)
  change
    (∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C,
      Complex.normSq (f (LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation q phi₀
            p.2.1 p.2.2 (p.1 : Fin n → ZMod 2)).comp
              (Submodule.mkQ A'))))) /
      (Fintype.card (Σ w : Outside, C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η
  rw [hsum]
  simpa [A', X, X', q, C, Outside, Q'] using hbound


/-- Every quotient-coset conditional source mean is bounded by `2η`.
The zero coset is the stable source law; each nonzero coset is the outside
column law in its one-dimensional span extension. The section coordinates
are fixed once from the source functional, before the coset is chosen. -/
theorem actual_source_quotient_coset_mean_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
    let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
    let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
    let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let qdom : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
      (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
      LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
        (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
          z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))
    ∀ q : (Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation,
    (∑ p : Σ w : {w : Fin n → ZMod 2 //
          Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w = q}, C,
        Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : {w : Fin n → ZMod 2 //
          Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w = q}, C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
  let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let qdom : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let QStable : ActualAffineRestriction n d :=
    { domainFixed := A', codomainVariation := Q.codomainVariation,
      base := Q.base }
  let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
    (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
  let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
        z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))
  have hcoords := actual_expanded_source_coordinates_coe_uniform
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv Q.codomainVariation
  rcases hcoords with ⟨hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp, hmatrix⟩
  have hstable := actual_stable_source_energy_le_of_coordinates
    f hf Q hQ phi v hv sCoord phi₀ hqs hqv hphiS hphiV hdecomp
  intro q
  by_cases hzero : q = (0 : (Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation)
  · subst q
    let F0 := {w : Fin n → ZMod 2 //
      Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w = 0}
    let e0 : F0 ≃ Q.codomainVariation :=
      { toFun := fun w => ⟨w.1, by
          have hk : w.1 ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation) :=
            LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr w.2
          rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ] at hk
          exact hk⟩
        invFun := fun b => ⟨b, by simp⟩
        left_inv := by intro w; apply Subtype.ext; rfl
        right_inv := by intro b; apply Subtype.ext; rfl }
    let e0Sigma : (Σ w : F0, C) ≃ (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C) :=
      Equiv.sigmaCongr e0 (fun _ => Equiv.refl C)
    have hsum0 :
        (∑ p : Σ w : F0, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) =
        ∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C,
          Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2))) := by
      let g : (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C) → ℝ := fun p =>
        Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))
      calc
        (∑ p : Σ w : F0, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) =
            ∑ p : Σ w : F0, C, g (e0Sigma p) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro p hp
              rcases p with ⟨w, c⟩
              rfl
        _ = ∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C, g p :=
          Fintype.sum_equiv e0Sigma (fun p => g (e0Sigma p)) g (by
            intro p
            rfl)
    have hcard0 : Fintype.card (Σ w : F0, C) =
        Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C) :=
      Fintype.card_congr e0Sigma
    have hstat :
        (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C,
          Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) =
        ∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C,
          Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv QStable).symm
            (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
              p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)).1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hm := actual_stable_source_matrix_formula Q phi v hv
        phi₀ p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1
      simpa [sample, A', qdom, QStable] using
        congrArg (fun M => Complex.normSq (f M)) hm.symm
    have hmean :
        (∑ p : Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C,
          Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv QStable).symm
            (stableSourceSampleMap Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
              p.2.1 p.2.2 p.1)).1)) /
          (Fintype.card (Σ w : Q.codomainVariation, C) : ℝ) ≤ η := by
      simpa [A', X, qdom, C] using hstable
    have hη := actual_source_parameter_nonneg f hf
    have htwice : η ≤ 2 * η := by linarith
    rw [hsum0, hcard0]
    rw [hstat]
    exact hmean.trans htwice
  · let w₀ := Classical.choose (Submodule.mkQ_surjective Q.codomainVariation q)
    have hw₀q : Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w₀ = q :=
      Classical.choose_spec (Submodule.mkQ_surjective Q.codomainVariation q)
    have hw₀ : w₀ ∉ Q.codomainVariation := by
      intro hw
      have hk : w₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker (Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation) := by
        rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
        exact hw
      have hzero' := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hk
      apply hzero
      calc
        q = Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w₀ := hw₀q.symm
        _ = 0 := hzero'
    let B' := spanExtensionSubmodule Q.codomainVariation w₀
    have hB : Q.codomainVariation ≤ B' := by
      dsimp [B', spanExtensionSubmodule]
      exact le_sup_left
    have hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' =
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) Q.codomainVariation + 1 := by
      exact Submodule.finrank_sup_span_singleton hw₀
    have hexpanded := actual_expanded_source_energy_le_two_common_coordinates
      f hf Q hQ phi v hv B' hB hdim
    let Outside := {u : B' // (u : Fin n → ZMod 2) ∉ Q.codomainVariation}
    let Fq := {w : Fin n → ZMod 2 //
      Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w = q}
    let ec : Fq ≃ Outside :=
      let e0 := quotientCosetFibreEquiv_extension Q.codomainVariation w₀ hw₀
      { toFun := fun w => e0
          ⟨w.1, w.2.trans hw₀q.symm⟩
        invFun := fun u =>
          ⟨(e0.symm u).1, (e0.symm u).2.trans hw₀q⟩
        left_inv := by
          intro w
          apply Subtype.ext
          change (e0.symm (e0 ⟨w.1, w.2.trans hw₀q.symm⟩)).1 = w.1
          exact congrArg Subtype.val
            (e0.left_inv ⟨w.1, w.2.trans hw₀q.symm⟩)
        right_inv := by
          intro u
          apply Subtype.ext
          change (e0 (e0.symm u)).1 = u.1
          exact congrArg Subtype.val
            (e0.right_inv u) }
    let eSigma : (Σ w : Fq, C) ≃ (Σ w : Outside, C) :=
      Equiv.sigmaCongr ec (fun _ => Equiv.refl C)
    have hsum :
        (∑ p : Σ w : Fq, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) =
        ∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2))) := by
      let g : (Σ w : Outside, C) → ℝ := fun p =>
        Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))
      calc
        (∑ p : Σ w : Fq, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) =
            ∑ p : Σ w : Fq, C, g (eSigma p) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro p hp
              rcases p with ⟨w, c⟩
              change Complex.normSq (f (sample (w.1, c))) =
                Complex.normSq (f (sample ((ec w).1.1, c)))
              have hw : (ec w).1.1 = w.1 := rfl
              rw [hw]
        _ = ∑ p : Σ w : Outside, C, g p := by
          exact Fintype.sum_equiv eSigma
            (fun p => g (eSigma p)) g (by intro p; rfl)
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Σ w : Fq, C) =
        Fintype.card (Σ w : Outside, C) := Fintype.card_congr eSigma
    dsimp [A', X, qdom, C, B', Outside, Fq] at hexpanded
    change
      (∑ p : Σ w : Fq, C, Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.1.1, p.2)))) /
        (Fintype.card (Σ w : Fq, C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η
    rw [hsum, hcard]
    exact hexpanded

/-- The quotient-coset conditional estimates combine into the full source
sample mean by the exact finite quotient partition of the distinguished
column. -/
theorem actual_source_all_columns_mean_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
    let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
    let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
    let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let qdom : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
      (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
      LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
        (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
          z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))
    (∑ z : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C, Complex.normSq (f (sample z))) /
      (Fintype.card ((Fin n → ZMod 2) × C) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let sCoord := Classical.choose hsource
  let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let qdom : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let C := (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation) ×
    (X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
  let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
        z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))
  let g : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → ℝ :=
    fun z => Complex.normSq (f (sample z))
  have hcoset := actual_source_quotient_coset_mean_le_two f hf Q hQ phi v hv
  apply quotientCoset_partition_mean_le_two Q.codomainVariation g
  intro q
  let Fq := {w : Fin n → ZMod 2 //
    Submodule.mkQ Q.codomainVariation w = q}
  let S := Σ w : Fq, C
  let e : S ≃ Fq × C :=
    { toFun := fun p => (p.1, p.2)
      invFun := fun z => ⟨z.1, z.2⟩
      left_inv := fun p => rfl
      right_inv := fun z => rfl }
  have hsum : (∑ p : S, g (p.1.1, p.2)) =
      ∑ z : Fq × C, g (z.1.1, z.2) := by
    exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun z : Fq × C => g (z.1.1, z.2))
  have hcard : Fintype.card S = Fintype.card (Fq × C) :=
    Fintype.card_congr e
  have hq := hcoset q
  rw [← hsum, ← hcard]
  simpa [A', X, X', qdom, C, sample, g, Fq, S, phi₀] using hq

/-- The source sample is the actual parent-fibre matrix plus the line
translation. This identity is independent of a choice of basis and is the
operator bridge needed to apply Jensen to `E_U`. -/
theorem quotientSampleOutput_eq_parent_add_line
    {K X X' W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X] [AddCommGroup X'] [Module K X']
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A' A : Submodule K X) (hA : A' ≤ A)
    (B : Submodule K W)
    (phi₀ : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] K)
    (R : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B) (lambda : (X ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] K) (w : W) :
    let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ A) :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) hA
    let phiExt : X →ₗ[K] K :=
      phi₀.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') + lambda.comp (Submodule.mkQ A)
    (quotientSampleOutput B q phi₀ R lambda w).comp (Submodule.mkQ A') =
      B.subtype.comp (R.comp (Submodule.mkQ A)) + phiExt.smulRight w := by
  classical
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) hA
  let phiExt : X →ₗ[K] K :=
    phi₀.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') + lambda.comp (Submodule.mkQ A)
  have hfactor : q.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') = Submodule.mkQ A := by
    ext x
    rfl
  ext x
  simp [quotientSampleOutput, phiExt, LinearMap.comp_apply, hfactor]

/-! Finite complex Jensen used by the actual A18 sampling argument. -/
theorem normSq_finite_average_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (z : α → ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq ((∑ a, z a) / (Fintype.card α : ℂ)) ≤
      (∑ a, Complex.normSq (z a)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
  have hr := sum_div_card_sq_le_sum_sq_div_card
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (f := fun a => (z a).re)
  have hi := sum_div_card_sq_le_sum_sq_div_card
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (f := fun a => (z a).im)
  simpa [Complex.normSq_apply, ← pow_two, div_pow, add_div,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib] using add_le_add hr hi

/-- Jensen in the line variables, followed by averaging the parent-fibre
variable. This form is the exact normalization needed before applying the
all-columns source bound. -/
theorem normSq_iterated_average_le
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (z : α → β → ℂ) :
    (∑ a, Complex.normSq
        ((∑ b, z a b) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ))) /
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ p : α × β, Complex.normSq (z p.1 p.2)) /
        (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℝ) := by
  have hpoint (a : α) := normSq_finite_average_le (z a)
  have hsum :
      (∑ a, Complex.normSq
        ((∑ b, z a b) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ))) ≤
      ∑ a, (∑ b, Complex.normSq (z a b)) /
        (Fintype.card β : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a ha => hpoint a)
  have hα : 0 < (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hβ : (Fintype.card β : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hα).2
  calc
    (∑ a, Complex.normSq
      ((∑ b, z a b) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ))) ≤
      ∑ a, (∑ b, Complex.normSq (z a b)) /
        (Fintype.card β : ℝ) := hsum
    _ = ((∑ p : α × β, Complex.normSq (z p.1 p.2)) /
        (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℝ)) * (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
        Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
      field_simp [hβ, hα.ne']

/-- Jensen in the source line variables after fixing the restriction of the
functional to the parent domain. The right side is exactly the all-columns
sample already bounded above; this is the conditional A18 energy step. -/
theorem actual_fixed_functional_line_average_energy_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
    let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
    let qdom : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let R := X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation
    let Lambda := X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2
    let C := R × Lambda
    let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
      LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
        (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom
          (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
            (quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
              Q.domainFixed phi v hv))) z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp
          (Submodule.mkQ A'))
    let lineMean (r : R) :=
      (∑ p : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × Lambda,
        f (sample (p.1, (r, p.2)))) /
        (Fintype.card ((Fin n → ZMod 2) × Lambda) : ℂ)
    (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq (lineMean r)) / (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤
      2 * η := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let X := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed
  let X' := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A'
  let qdom : X' →ₗ[ZMod 2] X :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let R := X →ₗ[ZMod 2] Q.codomainVariation
  let Lambda := X →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2
  let C := R × Lambda
  let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hsource)
  let sample : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × C → BinaryMatrix n d := fun z =>
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀
        z.2.1 z.2.2 z.1).comp (Submodule.mkQ A'))
  let lineMean (r : R) :=
    (∑ p : (Fin n → ZMod 2) × Lambda,
      f (sample (p.1, (r, p.2)))) /
      (Fintype.card ((Fin n → ZMod 2) × Lambda) : ℂ)
  let W := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let e : R × (W × Lambda) ≃ W × (R × Lambda) :=
    { toFun := fun p => (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2))
      invFun := fun p => (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2))
      left_inv := fun p => rfl
      right_inv := fun p => rfl }
  have hsum :
      (∑ p : R × (W × Lambda),
        Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2))))) =
      ∑ z : W × (R × Lambda), Complex.normSq (f (sample z)) := by
    exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun z => Complex.normSq (f (sample z)))
  have hcard : Fintype.card (R × (W × Lambda)) =
      Fintype.card (W × (R × Lambda)) := Fintype.card_congr e
  have hiter := normSq_iterated_average_le
    (fun r : R => fun p : W × Lambda =>
      f (sample (p.1, (r, p.2))))
  have hall := actual_source_all_columns_mean_le_two
    f hf Q hQ phi v hv
  have hall' :
      (∑ z : W × (R × Lambda), Complex.normSq (f (sample z))) /
        (Fintype.card (W × (R × Lambda)) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
    simpa [A', X, X', qdom, C, sample, R, Lambda, W, hsource, phi₀] using hall
  have hsourceavg :
      (∑ p : R × (W × Lambda),
        Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2))))) /
        (Fintype.card (R × (W × Lambda)) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
    rw [hsum, hcard]
    exact hall'
  have hiter' :
      (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq (lineMean r)) / (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤
        (∑ p : R × (W × Lambda),
          Complex.normSq (f (sample (p.2.1, (p.1, p.2.2))))) /
          (Fintype.card (R × (W × Lambda)) : ℝ) := by
    simpa [A', X, X', qdom, C, R, Lambda, W, sample, lineMean] using hiter
  change (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq (lineMean r)) /
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η
  exact hiter'.trans hsourceavg

/-- The canonical reference functional selected by the restricted-kernel
coordinates extends the given functional on the parent domain. -/
noncomputable def restrictedFunctionalReference
    {K X : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    X →ₗ[K] K :=
  (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
    (quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv))).comp
      (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient A phi))

theorem restrictedFunctionalReference_extends
    {K X : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    (restrictedFunctionalReference A phi v hv).comp A.subtype = phi := by
  classical
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient A phi
  let q : (X ⧸ A') →ₗ[K] (X ⧸ A) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := A) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let hsource := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional A phi v hv
  let s := Classical.choose hsource
  let hphiSource := Classical.choose_spec hsource
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose hphiSource
  have hparts := Classical.choose_spec hphiSource
  rcases hparts with ⟨hqs, hqv, hphiS, hphiV, hdecomp⟩
  have hfactor : q.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') = Submodule.mkQ A := by
    ext x
    rfl
  ext a
  let xq := Submodule.mkQ A' (a : X)
  have hqzero : q xq = 0 := by
    have hx := congrArg (fun F : X →ₗ[K] X ⧸ A => F a) hfactor
    have hx' : q xq = Submodule.mkQ A (a : X) := by
      simpa [xq, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx
    exact hx'.trans ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mpr a.property)
  have hclass : xq = phi₀ xq • Submodule.mkQ A' (v : X) := by
    have h := hdecomp xq
    rw [hqzero] at h
    simpa [phi₀] using h
  have hquot : Submodule.mkQ A' (a : X) =
      Submodule.mkQ A' ((phi₀ xq • v : A) : X) := by
    simpa [xq, map_smul] using hclass
  have hdiff : ((a - phi₀ xq • v : A) : X) ∈ A' := by
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq A').1 hquot
  change ((a - phi₀ xq • v : A) : X) ∈
    (LinearMap.ker phi).map A.subtype at hdiff
  rcases hdiff with ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
  have hba' : b = a - phi₀ xq • v := Subtype.ext hba
  have hker := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hb
  rw [hba'] at hker
  have hvalue : phi a = phi₀ xq := by
    have hzero : phi a - phi₀ xq = 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_smul, hv] using hker
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero)
  change phi₀ xq = phi a
  exact hvalue.symm

/-- Global linear functionals extending a fixed restricted functional are
in bijection with the quotient functionals. This is the dependent
reindexing from the manuscript's uniform `phi` draw to the source
coordinates. -/
noncomputable def restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv
    {K X : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (A : Submodule K X) (phi : A →ₗ[K] K) (v : A) (hv : phi v = 1) :
    (X ⧸ A →ₗ[K] K) ≃ {psi : X →ₗ[K] K // psi.comp A.subtype = phi} := by
  classical
  let phiRef := restrictedFunctionalReference A phi v hv
  refine
    { toFun := fun lambda => ⟨phiRef + lambda.comp (Submodule.mkQ A), ?_⟩
      invFun := fun psi =>
        A.liftQ (psi.1 - phiRef) (by
          intro a ha
          apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
          have hpsi := congrArg (fun F : A →ₗ[K] K => F ⟨a, ha⟩) psi.2
          have href := congrArg (fun F : A →ₗ[K] K => F ⟨a, ha⟩)
            (restrictedFunctionalReference_extends A phi v hv)
          have heq : psi.1 a = phiRef a := by
            simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hpsi.trans href.symm
          simpa [LinearMap.sub_apply] using sub_eq_zero.mpr heq)
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro a
    have href := congrArg (fun F : A →ₗ[K] K => F a)
      (restrictedFunctionalReference_extends A phi v hv)
    have href' : phiRef (a : X) = phi a := by
      simpa [phiRef, LinearMap.comp_apply] using href
    change phiRef (a : X) + lambda (Submodule.mkQ A (a : X)) = phi a
    rw [href']
    have hmk : Submodule.mkQ A (a : X) = 0 :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mpr a.property
    simp [hmk]
  · intro lambda
    let F : X →ₗ[K] K :=
      (phiRef + lambda.comp (Submodule.mkQ A)) - phiRef
    have hk : A ≤ LinearMap.ker F := by
      intro a ha
      apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      have hmk : Submodule.mkQ A (a : X) = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mpr ha
      simp [F, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, hmk]
    have hlift := A.liftQ_mkQ F hk
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ y ?_
    intro x
    have hy := congrArg (fun g : X →ₗ[K] K => g x) hlift
    change (A.liftQ F hk) (Submodule.mkQ A x) = lambda (Submodule.mkQ A x)
    simpa [F, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply] using hy
  · intro psi
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    let F : X →ₗ[K] K := psi.1 - phiRef
    have hk : A ≤ LinearMap.ker F := by
      intro a ha
      apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      have hmk : Submodule.mkQ A a = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).mpr ha
      have hpsi := congrArg (fun g : A →ₗ[K] K => g ⟨a, ha⟩) psi.2
      have href := congrArg (fun g : A →ₗ[K] K => g ⟨a, ha⟩)
        (restrictedFunctionalReference_extends A phi v hv)
      have heq : psi.1 a = phiRef a := by
        simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hpsi.trans href.symm
      simpa [F, LinearMap.sub_apply, hmk] using sub_eq_zero.mpr heq
    have hlift := A.liftQ_mkQ F hk
    have hx := congrArg (fun g : X →ₗ[K] K => g x) hlift
    have hx' : (A.liftQ F hk) (Submodule.mkQ A x) = F x := by
      simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx
    change phiRef x + (A.liftQ F hk) (Submodule.mkQ A x) = psi.1 x
    rw [hx']
    dsimp [F]
    abel

/-- Changing the restricted functional by equality does not change the
inverse extension coordinate. The proof fields in the subtype are
propositionally irrelevant. -/
private theorem restrictedFunctionalExtension_symm_congr
    {K X : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (A : Submodule K X) (v : A)
    (phi₁ phi₂ : A →ₗ[K] K) (hphi : phi₁ = phi₂)
    (hv₁ : phi₁ v = 1) (hv₂ : phi₂ v = 1)
    (psi : X →ₗ[K] K)
    (h₁ : psi.comp A.subtype = phi₁) (h₂ : psi.comp A.subtype = phi₂) :
    (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A phi₁ v hv₁).symm ⟨psi, h₁⟩ =
      (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A phi₂ v hv₂).symm ⟨psi, h₂⟩ := by
  cases hphi
  have hargs :
      (⟨psi, h₁⟩ : {psi : X →ₗ[K] K // psi.comp A.subtype = phi₁}) =
        ⟨psi, h₂⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [hargs]

/-- Reindex the uniform global functionals with value one on `v` by their
restriction to `A` and the residual functional on `X ⧸ A`. -/
noncomputable def globalFunctionalRestrictionEquiv
    {K X : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup X] [Module K X]
    (A : Submodule K X) (v : A) :
    {psi : X →ₗ[K] K // psi (v : X) = 1} ≃
      Σ phi : {phi : A →ₗ[K] K // phi v = 1}, X ⧸ A →ₗ[K] K := by
  classical
  let Phi := {phi : A →ₗ[K] K // phi v = 1}
  let Global := {psi : X →ₗ[K] K // psi (v : X) = 1}
  let restrict : Global → Phi := fun psi =>
    ⟨psi.1.comp A.subtype, by
      simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using psi.2⟩
  let residual : (psi : Global) → X ⧸ A →ₗ[K] K := fun psi =>
    (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A (restrict psi).1 v
      (restrict psi).2).symm ⟨psi.1, rfl⟩
  let assemble : (p : Σ phi : Phi, X ⧸ A →ₗ[K] K) → Global := fun p =>
    let ext := restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2 p.2
    ⟨ext.1, by
      have h := congrArg (fun g : A →ₗ[K] K => g v) ext.2
      simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using h.trans p.1.2⟩
  refine
    { toFun := fun psi => ⟨restrict psi, residual psi⟩
      invFun := assemble
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · intro psi
    apply Subtype.ext
    let phi := restrict psi
    let e := restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A phi.1 v phi.2
    have h := e.apply_symm_apply ⟨psi.1, rfl⟩
    change (e (e.symm ⟨psi.1, rfl⟩)).1 = psi.1
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro p
    apply Sigma.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro a
      let e := restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2
      have h := (e p.2).2
      change ((assemble p).1.comp A.subtype) a = p.1.1 a
      exact congrArg (fun g : A →ₗ[K] K => g a) h
    · apply heq_of_eq
      have hphi : restrict (assemble p) = p.1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro a
        let e := restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2
        have h := (e p.2).2
        change ((assemble p).1.comp A.subtype) a = p.1.1 a
        exact congrArg (fun g : A →ₗ[K] K => g a) h
      have hphiVal := congrArg Subtype.val hphi
      change residual (assemble p) = p.2
      dsimp [residual]
      calc
        (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A (restrict (assemble p)).1 v
            (restrict (assemble p)).2).symm ⟨(assemble p).1, rfl⟩ =
          (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2).symm
            ((restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2) p.2) := by
              exact restrictedFunctionalExtension_symm_congr A v
                (restrict (assemble p)).1 p.1.1 hphiVal
                (restrict (assemble p)).2 p.1.2 (assemble p).1 rfl
                ((restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2 p.2).2)
        _ = p.2 :=
          (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A p.1.1 v p.1.2).symm_apply_apply p.2

end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18SourceGlobal

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic

/-!
The manuscript's actual affine fibre, in basis-free quotient-Hom coordinates.
The equivalence is exact and transports the normalized finite energy by
reindexing; it introduces no energy or event-mass hypothesis.
-/
namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46ActualFibreModel

open BinaryMatrixActualAffine BinaryMatrixComplexA15
open BinaryMatrixFourier PvNP.RealizableHardness.MatrixLiftNominalDomain
open PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18Conditioning
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local instance] Fintype.ofFinite

variable {K V W : Type*} [Field K]
variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]

abbrev QuotientHom (A : Submodule K V) (B : Submodule K W) :=
  (V ⧸ A) →ₗ[K] B

def ConstrainedMap (A : Submodule K V) (B : Submodule K W) :=
  {f : V →ₗ[K] W // f.comp A.subtype = 0 ∧ LinearMap.range f ≤ B}

noncomputable def quotientHomEquiv (A : Submodule K V) (B : Submodule K W) :
    QuotientHom A B ≃ ConstrainedMap A B where
  toFun g :=
    ⟨B.subtype.comp (g.comp A.mkQ), by
      constructor
      · ext x
        change ((g (A.mkQ (x : V)) : B) : W) = 0
        have hx : A.mkQ (x : V) = 0 := by
          have hxker : (x : V) ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mkQ := by
            simpa only [Submodule.ker_mkQ] using x.property
          exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hxker
        simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hx]
      · intro y hy
        rcases hy with ⟨x, hx⟩
        change y ∈ B
        rw [← hx]
        exact (g (A.mkQ x)).property⟩
  invFun f := by
    let fB : V →ₗ[K] B := f.1.codRestrict B (fun x =>
      f.2.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    have hk : A ≤ LinearMap.ker fB := by
      intro x hx
      apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hz := congrArg (fun q : A →ₗ[K] W => q ⟨x, hx⟩) f.2.1
      simpa [fB] using hz
    exact A.liftQ fB hk
  left_inv g := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ x ?_
    intro y
    let fB : V →ₗ[K] B := g.comp A.mkQ
    have hk : A ≤ LinearMap.ker fB := by
      intro z hz
      apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hq : A.mkQ (z : V) = 0 := by
        have hqker : (z : V) ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mkQ := by
          simpa only [Submodule.ker_mkQ] using hz
        exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hqker
      simp [fB, LinearMap.comp_apply, hq]
    have hlift := A.liftQ_mkQ fB hk
    have hy := congrArg (fun q : V →ₗ[K] B => q y) hlift
    change (A.liftQ fB hk) (A.mkQ y) = g (A.mkQ y)
    simpa [fB] using hy
  right_inv f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    let fB : V →ₗ[K] B := f.1.codRestrict B (fun y =>
      f.2.2 ⟨y, rfl⟩)
    have hk : A ≤ LinearMap.ker fB := by
        intro y hy
        apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hz := congrArg (fun q : A →ₗ[K] W => q ⟨y, hy⟩) f.2.1
        simpa [fB] using hz
    have h := A.liftQ_mkQ fB hk
    have hx := congrArg (fun q : V →ₗ[K] B => q x) h
    simpa [fB] using congrArg Subtype.val hx

theorem actualAffineDifference_iff {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (M : BinaryMatrix n d) :
    M ∈ Q.fibre ↔
      (Matrix.toLin' (M - Q.base)).comp Q.domainFixed.subtype = 0 ∧
      LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' (M - Q.base)) ≤ Q.codomainVariation := by
  rw [actualFibre_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
    constructor
    · ext a x
      have ha := congrArg (fun z => z a) hA
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply] at ha
      change ((M - Q.base).mulVec (Q.domainFixed.subtype a)) x = 0
      rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (congrArg (fun z : Fin n → ZMod 2 => z x) ha)
    · intro z hz
      rcases hz with ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hX := congrArg (fun z => z y) hB
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hX
      have hz : actualLeftMap Q ((M - Q.base).mulVec y) = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, map_sub]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hX
      exact (ker_actualLeftMap Q) ▸ LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hz
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
    constructor
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro a
      have ha := congrArg
        (fun q : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) => q a) hA
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply] at ha
      have ha' : Matrix.mulVec M (Q.domainFixed.subtype a) -
          Matrix.mulVec Q.base (Q.domainFixed.subtype a) = 0 := by
        simpa [Matrix.sub_mulVec] using ha
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply] using
        sub_eq_zero.mp ha'
    · apply LinearMap.ext
      intro y
      have hy := hB ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hz : actualLeftMap Q ((M - Q.base).mulVec y) = 0 := by
        exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ((ker_actualLeftMap Q).symm ▸ hy)
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply]
      have hz' := hz
      rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, map_sub] at hz'
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz'

noncomputable def actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) :
    {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre} ≃
      QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation := by
  let e₁ : {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre} ≃
      {f : (Fin d → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) //
        f.comp Q.domainFixed.subtype =
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base).comp Q.domainFixed.subtype ∧
        (actualLeftMap Q).comp f =
          (actualLeftMap Q).comp (Matrix.toLin' Q.base)} :=
    actualFibreLinearEquiv Q
  let e₂ :
      {f : (Fin d → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) //
        f.comp Q.domainFixed.subtype =
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base).comp Q.domainFixed.subtype ∧
        (actualLeftMap Q).comp f =
          (actualLeftMap Q).comp (Matrix.toLin' Q.base)} ≃
        ConstrainedMap Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation := {
    toFun := fun L => by
      refine ⟨L.1 - Matrix.toLin' Q.base, ?_⟩
      constructor
      · apply LinearMap.ext
        intro a
        have h := congrArg (fun q : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) => q a) L.2.1
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
        change L.1 a - (Matrix.toLin' Q.base) a = 0
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
      · intro z hz
        rcases hz with ⟨x, rfl⟩
        have h := congrArg
          (fun q : (Fin d → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
            (Fin (Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
              ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.codomainVariation)) → ZMod 2) => q x)
          L.2.2
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
        have hz : actualLeftMap Q ((L.1 - Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x) = 0 := by
          change actualLeftMap Q (L.1 x - (Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x) = 0
          rw [map_sub]
          exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
        have hzvar : (L.1 - Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x ∈ Q.codomainVariation := by
          have hzker : (L.1 - Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x ∈
              LinearMap.ker (actualLeftMap Q) := LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hz
          exact (le_of_eq (ker_actualLeftMap Q)) hzker
        exact hzvar
    invFun := fun f => by
      refine ⟨f.1 + Matrix.toLin' Q.base, ?_⟩
      constructor
      · apply LinearMap.ext
        intro a
        have hz := congrArg (fun q : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2) => q a) f.2.1
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hz
        change f.1 (a : Fin d → ZMod 2) = 0 at hz
        change f.1 (a : Fin d → ZMod 2) +
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base) (a : Fin d → ZMod 2) =
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base) (a : Fin d → ZMod 2)
        rw [hz, zero_add]
      · apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        have hx := f.2.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩
        have hz : actualLeftMap Q (f.1 x) = 0 :=
          LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ((ker_actualLeftMap Q).symm ▸ hx)
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
        change actualLeftMap Q (f.1 x + (Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x) =
          actualLeftMap Q ((Matrix.toLin' Q.base) x)
        rw [map_add, hz, zero_add]
    left_inv := fun L => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact sub_add_cancel _ _
    right_inv := fun f => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact add_sub_cancel_right _ _
  }
  exact e₁.trans (e₂.trans (quotientHomEquiv Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation).symm)

theorem actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_energy {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) :
    fibreEnergy Q.fibre f =
      (∑ g : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation,
        Complex.normSq (f ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm g))) /
      (Fintype.card (QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let e := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q
  have hc : Fintype.card {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre} =
      Fintype.card (QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation) :=
    Fintype.card_congr e
  have hcard : Fintype.card {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre} = Q.fibre.card := by
    simp
  have hs : (∑ M ∈ Q.fibre, Complex.normSq (f M)) =
      ∑ M : {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre},
        Complex.normSq (f M.1) := by
    have hfibre :
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun M : BinaryMatrix n d => M ∈ Q.fibre)) =
          Q.fibre := by
      ext M
      simp [ActualAffineRestriction.fibre]
    calc
      (∑ M ∈ Q.fibre, Complex.normSq (f M)) =
          ∑ M ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun M : BinaryMatrix n d => M ∈ Q.fibre),
            Complex.normSq (f M) := by
              conv_lhs => rw [← hfibre]
      _ = ∑ M : {M : BinaryMatrix n d // M ∈ Q.fibre},
            Complex.normSq (f M.1) := by
              simpa only [Finset.subtype_univ] using
                (Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter
                  (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (BinaryMatrix n d)))
                  (p := fun M => M ∈ Q.fibre)
                  (fun M => Complex.normSq (f M))).symm
  rw [fibreEnergy, hs, ← hcard, hc]
  congr 1
  exact (Equiv.sum_comp e.symm
    (fun M => Complex.normSq (f M.1))).symm

/-- Product coordinates for a codimension-one outside event. -/
noncomputable def productOutsideEquiv {F W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) :
    {p : F × W // p.2 ∉ B} ≃ F × {w : W // w ∉ B} where
  toFun p := (p.1.1, ⟨p.1.2, p.2⟩)
  invFun p := ⟨(p.1, p.2.1), p.2.2⟩
  left_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext rfl rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Subtype.ext
      rfl

/-- The outside event has exactly half of the product mass when B has
codimension one in the binary codomain W. -/
theorem productOutside_card_bound {F W : Type*} [Fintype F]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W)
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) W = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1) :
    Fintype.card (F × W) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card {p : F × W // p.2 ∉ B} := by
  classical
  have htopdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1 := by simpa using hdim
  have hcompTop := binary_submodule_complement_card_eq B ⊤ le_top htopdim
  let eTop : {w : W // w ∉ B} ≃
      {w : (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) // (w : W) ∉ B} :=
    { toFun := fun w => ⟨⟨w.1, Submodule.mem_top⟩, w.2⟩
      invFun := fun w => ⟨w.1.1, w.2⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro w
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      right_inv := by
        intro w
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl }
  have hcomp : Fintype.card {w : W // w ∉ B} = Fintype.card B := by
    calc
      Fintype.card {w : W // w ∉ B} =
          Fintype.card {w : (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) // (w : W) ∉ B} :=
        Fintype.card_congr eTop
      _ = Fintype.card B := by
        simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using hcompTop
  have hW : Fintype.card W = 2 * Fintype.card B := by
    have hWpow : Fintype.card W = 2 ^ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) W := by
      simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := W))
    have hBpow : Fintype.card B = 2 ^ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B := by
      simpa using (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank (K := ZMod 2) (V := B))
    rw [hWpow, hBpow, hdim, pow_succ]
    ring
  have hprod : Fintype.card {p : F × W // p.2 ∉ B} =
      Fintype.card F * Fintype.card B := by
    rw [Fintype.card_congr (productOutsideEquiv B), Fintype.card_prod, hcomp]
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, hprod]
  calc
    Fintype.card F * Fintype.card W =
        2 * (Fintype.card F * Fintype.card B) := by rw [hW]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card F * Fintype.card B) := le_rfl

/-- Conditioning a uniform full-space linear map on its new vector value
lying outside a codimension-one binary subspace costs at most two. This is
the actual vector-valued E_U law on `A + span{w}`; it follows from the exact
restriction/column equivalence and the finite half-mass count. -/
theorem dualSupVectorOutside_mean_le_two {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module (ZMod 2) V] [Fintype V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] [Fintype W]
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) V) {w : V} (hw : w ∉ A)
    (B : Submodule (ZMod 2) W)
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) W = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B + 1)
    (g : (spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ f, 0 ≤ g f) :
    (∑ f : {f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W //
        dualSupVectorColumn A w f ∉ B}, g f.1) /
        (Fintype.card {f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W //
          dualSupVectorColumn A w f ∉ B} : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((∑ f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W, g f) /
        (Fintype.card (spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) : ℝ)) := by
  classical
  let e : (spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) ≃ₗ[ZMod 2]
      ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) := dualSupVectorCoordinateEquiv A hw
  let p : ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) → Prop := fun x => x.2 ∉ B
  let G : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W → ℝ := fun x => g (e.symm x)
  have hprob := productOutside_card_bound (F := A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) B hdim
  have hprob' : Fintype.card ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) ≤
      2 * Fintype.card {x : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W // p x} :=
    productOutside_card_bound (F := A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) B hdim
  have hprobFilter :
      Fintype.card ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) ≤
        2 * (Finset.univ.filter p).card := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using hprob'
  have hαpos : 0 < Fintype.card ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  have hfilterpos : 0 < Fintype.card {x : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W // p x} := by
    omega
  have hne : (Finset.univ.filter p).Nonempty := by
    rcases Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hfilterpos with ⟨x⟩
    exact ⟨x.1, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, x.2⟩⟩
  have hcond := conditional_uniform_mean_le_two p hne hprobFilter G
    (fun x => hg (e.symm x))
  have hsumFilter : (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W)).filter p, G x) =
      ∑ x : {x : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W // p x}, G x.1 := by
    simpa only [Finset.subtype_univ] using
      (Finset.sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter
        (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W)))
        (p := p) G).symm
  have hsumOutside := dualSupVectorOutside_sum A w hw B g
  have hcardOutside := Fintype.card_congr (dualSupVectorOutsideEquiv A w hw B)
  have hsumAll : (∑ f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W, g f) =
      ∑ x : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W, G x := by
    simpa [G] using (Equiv.sum_comp e.toEquiv G)
  have hcardAll : Fintype.card (spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) =
      Fintype.card ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) := Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv
  calc
    (∑ f : {f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W //
        dualSupVectorColumn A w f ∉ B}, g f.1) /
        (Fintype.card {f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W //
          dualSupVectorColumn A w f ∉ B} : ℝ) =
      (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W)).filter p, G x) /
        ((Finset.univ.filter p).card : ℝ) := by
          rw [hsumOutside, ← hsumFilter, hcardOutside,
            Fintype.card_subtype]
    _ ≤ 2 * ((∑ x : (A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W, G x) /
        (Fintype.card ((A →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) × W) : ℝ)) := hcond
    _ = 2 * ((∑ f : spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W, g f) /
        (Fintype.card (spanExtensionSubmodule A w →ₗ[ZMod 2] W) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [hsumAll, hcardAll]

end

open ActualBinaryMatrixHC46FinitePeeling
