private abbrev F := ZMod 2
private abbrev V (d : Nat) := Fin d → F
private abbrev W (n : Nat) := Fin n → F

/-- A source-chosen sequence of one-dimensional quotient-domain directions.
Each child is the actual larger ambient subspace, retaining the quotient
inclusions used by the A1 carrier identities. -/
inductive DomainLineFlag {d : Nat} :
    Submodule F (V d) → Nat → Type 1
  | done (A : Submodule F (V d)) : DomainLineFlag A 0
  | cons {A A' : Submodule F (V d)}
      (hA : A ≤ A')
      (hL : Module.finrank F (A'.map A.mkQ) = 1)
      {k : Nat} (tail : DomainLineFlag A' k) : DomainLineFlag A (k + 1)

/-- A source-chosen sequence of codomain hyperplanes. The carrier after each
step is exactly the ambient image of the chosen hyperplane. -/
inductive CodomainHyperplaneFlag {n : Nat} :
    Submodule F (W n) → Nat → Type 1
  | done (B : Submodule F (W n)) : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B 0
  | cons {B : Submodule F (W n)} (H : Submodule F B)
      (hH : Module.finrank F (B ⧸ H) = 1) {k : Nat}
      (tail : CodomainHyperplaneFlag (H.map B.subtype) k) :
      CodomainHyperplaneFlag B (k + 1)

/-- The exact terminal domain carrier selected by a domain-line flag. -/
def DomainLineFlag.endpoint {d : Nat} {A : Submodule F (V d)} {k : Nat} :
    DomainLineFlag A k → Submodule F (V d)
  | .done A => A
  | .cons _ _ tail => tail.endpoint

/-- Append one genuine one-dimensional quotient step at the terminal end of
an existing domain flag. This is the constructor needed to build a complete
flag upward from a recursively chosen hyperplane of the requested endpoint. -/
def DomainLineFlag.appendStep {d : Nat} {A0 : Submodule F (V d)}
    {k : Nat} (flag : DomainLineFlag A0 k)
    (Anew : Submodule F (V d))
    (hle : flag.endpoint ≤ Anew)
    (hstep : Module.finrank F (Anew.map flag.endpoint.mkQ) = 1) :
    DomainLineFlag A0 (k + 1) := by
  induction flag with
  | done A0 =>
      have hstep' : Module.finrank F (Anew.map A0.mkQ) = 1 := by
        change Module.finrank F (Anew.map (DomainLineFlag.endpoint (.done A0)).mkQ) = 1
        exact hstep
      exact .cons hle hstep' (.done Anew)
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail ih =>
      have hle' : tail.endpoint ≤ Anew := by
        change tail.endpoint ≤ Anew
        exact hle
      have hstep' : Module.finrank F (Anew.map tail.endpoint.mkQ) = 1 := by
        change Module.finrank F (Anew.map tail.endpoint.mkQ) = 1
        exact hstep
      exact .cons hA hL (ih hle' hstep')

/-- Appending a line step changes the endpoint to exactly the new target. -/
theorem DomainLineFlag.endpoint_appendStep {d : Nat} {A0 : Submodule F (V d)}
    {k : Nat} (flag : DomainLineFlag A0 k)
    (Anew : Submodule F (V d))
    (hle : flag.endpoint ≤ Anew)
    (hstep : Module.finrank F (Anew.map flag.endpoint.mkQ) = 1) :
  (flag.appendStep Anew hle hstep).endpoint = Anew := by
  induction flag with
  | done A0 => rfl
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail ih =>
      have hle' : tail.endpoint ≤ Anew := by
        change tail.endpoint ≤ Anew
        exact hle
      have hstep' : Module.finrank F (Anew.map tail.endpoint.mkQ) = 1 := by
        change Module.finrank F (Anew.map tail.endpoint.mkQ) = 1
        exact hstep
      exact ih hle hstep

/-- The exact terminal ambient codomain carrier selected by a hyperplane flag.
Each recursive flag is already expressed as a submodule of the same ambient
space, so its endpoint is the requested nested image itself. -/
def CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint {n : Nat} {B : Submodule F (W n)} {k : Nat} :
    CodomainHyperplaneFlag B k → Submodule F (W n)
  | .done B => B
  | .cons _ _ tail => tail.endpoint

/-- The dimension drops by exactly one at every step of a codomain flag. -/
theorem CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint_finrank {n : Nat}
    {B : Submodule F (W n)} {k : Nat}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B k) :
    Module.finrank F flag.endpoint + k = Module.finrank F B := by
  induction flag with
  | done B => rfl
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      have hquot := H.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
      have hmap : Module.finrank F (H.map B.subtype) = Module.finrank F H := by
        rw [Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
      change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (H.map B.subtype) =
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H at hmap
      have hstep : Module.finrank F (H.map B.subtype) + 1 = Module.finrank F B := by
        change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (H.map B.subtype) + 1 =
          Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B
        rw [hmap]
        change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) +
          Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B at hquot
        change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) = 1 at hH
        omega
      simp only [CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint]
      calc
        Module.finrank F tail.endpoint + (k + 1) =
            (Module.finrank F tail.endpoint + k) + 1 := by omega
        _ = Module.finrank F (H.map B.subtype) + 1 := by rw [ih]
        _ = Module.finrank F B := hstep

/-- The image of the current carrier in the quotient by an actual
codimension-one child has dimension one. This is the quotient-domain step
needed when reversing a hyperplane flag into a domain-line flag. -/
private theorem hyperplane_map_quotient_finrank_one {n : Nat}
    (B : Submodule F (W n)) (H : Submodule F B)
    (hH : Module.finrank F (B ⧸ H) = 1) :
    Module.finrank F (B.map (H.map B.subtype).mkQ) = 1 := by
  let B' : Submodule F (W n) := H.map B.subtype
  let q : B →ₗ[F] (W n ⧸ B') := B'.mkQ.comp B.subtype
  have hker : LinearMap.ker q = H := by
    ext x
    change q x = 0 ↔ x ∈ H
    change B'.mkQ (B.subtype x) = 0 ↔ x ∈ H
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    change B.subtype x ∈ B' ↔ x ∈ H
    change B.subtype x ∈ H.map B.subtype ↔ x ∈ H
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases Submodule.mem_map.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      have hyx : y = x := B.injective_subtype hxy
      simpa [hyx] using hy
    · intro hx
      exact Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hrange : LinearMap.range q = B.map B'.mkQ := by
    simp [q, B', LinearMap.range_comp]
  have hquot := q.quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq
  rw [hker, hrange] at hquot
  simpa [hH] using hquot.symm

/-- Reversing a genuine codomain-hyperplane flag gives a genuine
domain-line flag from its endpoint to its initial carrier. The dimension-one
certificate at each reversed step is computed from the actual quotient map. -/
theorem exists_reverse_codomain_flag {n : Nat}
    {B : Submodule F (W n)} {k : Nat}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B k) :
    ∃ lines : DomainLineFlag flag.endpoint k, lines.endpoint = B := by
  induction flag with
  | done B => exact ⟨.done B, rfl⟩
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨lines, hlines⟩
      have hle : lines.endpoint ≤ B := by
        rw [hlines]
        exact hyperplaneSuccessor_le B H
      have hstep :
          Module.finrank F (B.map lines.endpoint.mkQ) = 1 := by
        rw [hlines]
        exact hyperplane_map_quotient_finrank_one B H hH
      refine ⟨lines.appendStep B hle hstep, ?_⟩
      exact DomainLineFlag.endpoint_appendStep lines B hle hstep

/-- Choose a complete actual hyperplane flag in every finite binary
codomain subspace. The recursion uses an actual hyperplane of the current
subspace and terminates at its bottom subspace. -/
noncomputable def fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag {n : Nat} :
    (B : Submodule F (W n)) →
      CodomainHyperplaneFlag B (Module.finrank F B)
  | B => by
      classical
      by_cases hzero : Module.finrank F B = 0
      · have hB : B = ⊥ := (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero).mp hzero
        have hdone : CodomainHyperplaneFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (W n))
            (Module.finrank F (⊥ : Submodule F (W n))) := by
          have hfin : Module.finrank F (⊥ : Submodule F (W n)) = 0 := by simp
          rw [hfin]
          exact CodomainHyperplaneFlag.done (B := (⊥ : Submodule F (W n)))
        exact Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun S : Submodule F (W n) =>
            CodomainHyperplaneFlag S (Module.finrank F S)) hB.symm) hdone
      · have hbot : (⊥ : Submodule F B) ≠ ⊤ := by
          intro h
          have hdim := congrArg (fun S : Submodule F B => Module.finrank F S) h
          have hzero' : Module.finrank F B = 0 := by
            simpa [finrank_bot, finrank_top] using hdim.symm
          exact hzero hzero'
        let selected := Classical.choice
          (ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.exists_hyperplane_containing_of_ne_top
            (V := B) (⊥ : Submodule F B) hbot)
        let H : Submodule F B := selected.1.1
        have hcod :
            ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim (V := B) H = 1 :=
          selected.1.2
        have hquot : Module.finrank F (B ⧸ H) = 1 := by
          change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) = 1
          have hsub : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) +
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B :=
            H.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
          have hcod' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B -
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = 1 := by
            simpa only [ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim_eq_finrank_sub] using hcod
          omega
        let B' : Submodule F (W n) := H.map B.subtype
        have hdim : Module.finrank F B' + 1 = Module.finrank F B := by
          rw [Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq]
          change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H + 1 = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B
          have hsub : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) +
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B :=
            H.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
          have hcod' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B -
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = 1 := by
            simpa only [ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim_eq_finrank_sub] using hcod
          have hquot' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) = 1 := by omega
          have hmap' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (H.map B.subtype) =
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H := Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq B H
          omega
        change Module.finrank F B' + 1 = Module.finrank F B at hdim
        have tail := fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag B'
        rw [← hdim]
        exact CodomainHyperplaneFlag.cons (B := B) H hquot tail
termination_by B => Module.finrank F B
decreasing_by
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    (Nat.le_of_eq hdim)

/-- The full flag chosen above really descends from the requested carrier to
its bottom subspace, with no endpoint witness supplied by the caller. -/
theorem fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag_endpoint {n : Nat}
    (B : Submodule F (W n)) :
    (fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag B).endpoint = ⊥ := by
  have hdim :=
    CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint_finrank (fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag B)
  have hzero : Module.finrank F (fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag B).endpoint = 0 := by
    omega
  exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp hzero

/-- A codomain flag can descend from any finite carrier to any specified
subcarrier. At each recursive step the selected actual hyperplane contains
the target; recursion is on the dimension difference. -/
noncomputable def codomainFlagToSubcarrier {n : Nat} :
    (B K : Submodule F (W n)) → K ≤ B →
      {flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B
        (Module.finrank F B - Module.finrank F K) // flag.endpoint = K}
  | B, K, hKB => by
      classical
      by_cases hEq : B = K
      · subst K
        rw [Nat.sub_self]
        exact ⟨CodomainHyperplaneFlag.done B, rfl⟩
      · let KB : Submodule F B := K.comap B.subtype
        have hnot : ¬ B ≤ K := by
          intro hBK
          exact hEq (le_antisymm hBK hKB)
        have hKBtop : KB ≠ ⊤ := by
          intro htop
          apply hnot
          intro x hx
          have hxKB : (⟨x, hx⟩ : B) ∈ KB := by
            rw [htop]
            trivial
          simpa [KB] using hxKB
        let selected := Classical.choice
          (ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.exists_hyperplane_containing_of_ne_top
            (V := B) KB hKBtop)
        let H : Submodule F B := selected.1.1
        have hHcod :
            ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim (V := B) H = 1 :=
          selected.1.2
        have hH : Module.finrank F (B ⧸ H) = 1 := by
          change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) = 1
          have hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) +
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B :=
            H.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
          have hcod' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B -
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = 1 := by
            simpa only [ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim_eq_finrank_sub] using hHcod
          omega
        have hcontain : KB ≤ H := selected.2
        let B' : Submodule F (W n) := H.map B.subtype
        have hKB' : K ≤ B' := by
          intro x hx
          apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
          refine ⟨⟨x, hKB hx⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
          exact hcontain (by simpa [KB] using hx)
        have hKdim : Module.finrank F K ≤ Module.finrank F B' :=
          Submodule.finrank_mono hKB'
        change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) K ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' at hKdim
        have hmap : Module.finrank F B' = Module.finrank F H := by
          exact Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq B H
        change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H at hmap
        have hdim : Module.finrank F B' + 1 = Module.finrank F B := by
          change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' + 1 = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B
          rw [hmap]
          have hquot : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (B ⧸ H) +
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B :=
            H.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
          have hcod' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B -
              Module.finrank (ZMod 2) H = 1 := by
            simpa only [ActualMZ24HyperplaneSupport.relativeCodim_eq_finrank_sub] using hHcod
          omega
        have htail := codomainFlagToSubcarrier B' K hKB'
        have hKdim' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) K ≤ Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' := hKdim
        have hdim' : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' + 1 =
            Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B := hdim
        have hlen :
            (Module.finrank F B' - Module.finrank F K) + 1 =
              Module.finrank F B - Module.finrank F K := by
          change (Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B' - Module.finrank (ZMod 2) K) + 1 =
            Module.finrank (ZMod 2) B - Module.finrank (ZMod 2) K
          omega
        rw [← hlen]
        exact ⟨CodomainHyperplaneFlag.cons (B := B) H hH htail.1, htail.2⟩
termination_by B K hKB => Module.finrank F B
decreasing_by
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    (Nat.le_of_eq hdim)

/-- Every finite binary domain subspace admits a concrete complete line flag
from bottom to that exact endpoint, obtained by reversing the actual
hyperplane flag in the same ambient space. -/
theorem exists_full_domain_line_flag {d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) :
    ∃ lines : DomainLineFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
      (Module.finrank F A), lines.endpoint = A := by
  let flag := fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag A
  have hbottom : flag.endpoint = (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) :=
    fullCodomainHyperplaneFlag_endpoint A
  obtain ⟨lines, htop⟩ := exists_reverse_codomain_flag flag
  let lines' : DomainLineFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
      (Module.finrank F A) :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun X : Submodule F (V d) =>
      DomainLineFlag X (Module.finrank F A)) hbottom) lines
  have htransport {Aleft Aright : Submodule F (V d)} {k : Nat}
      (e : Aleft = Aright) (flag : DomainLineFlag Aleft k) :
      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun X : Submodule F (V d) =>
        DomainLineFlag X k) e) flag).endpoint = flag.endpoint := by
    cases e
    rfl
  have htop' : lines'.endpoint = A := by
    simpa only [lines'] using (htransport hbottom lines).trans htop
  exact ⟨lines', htop'⟩

/-- For every actual domain and codomain constraint there is a source-shaped
pair of endpoint-certified flags: domain lines run from bottom to `A`, and
codomain hyperplanes run from top to `B`. -/
theorem exists_canonical_source_flags {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n)) :
    ∃ lines : DomainLineFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
        (Module.finrank F A),
      lines.endpoint = A ∧
      ∃ hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
          (Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) - Module.finrank F B),
        hypers.endpoint = B := by
  obtain ⟨lines, hlines⟩ := exists_full_domain_line_flag A
  obtain ⟨hypers, hhypers⟩ :=
    codomainFlagToSubcarrier (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) B le_top
  exact ⟨lines, hlines, hypers, hhypers⟩

/-- Execute an all-zero-base hyperplane suffix as genuine typed A15 steps. -/
def buildHyperplaneSuffix {n d r : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex} :
    ∀ {h : Nat}, CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h →
      ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r h := by
  intro h flag
  induction flag with
  | done B => exact .done f r
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      exact .hyperplane hH 0 f
        (ih (f := fun N =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
            B H hH 0 f
            ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype
              B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)))

/-- Execute a hyperplane flag whose first step receives the specified affine
base; all later steps use zero base. -/
def buildHyperplanePrefix {n d r : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex} :
    ∀ {h : Nat}, CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h →
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r h
    := by
  intro h flag T
  induction flag with
  | done B => exact .done f r
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      exact .hyperplane hH T f
        (buildHyperplaneSuffix (f := fun N =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
            B H hH T f
            ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype
              B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)) tail)

/-- Execute a line flag suffix followed by the codomain hyperplane suffix;
all steps in both suffixes use zero base. -/
def buildLineSuffix {n d r : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex} :
    ∀ {l : Nat}, DomainLineFlag A l → ∀ {h : Nat},
    CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h →
    ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r (h + l) := by
  intro l lines h hypers
  induction lines generalizing h with
  | done A =>
      exact buildHyperplaneSuffix hypers
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail ih =>
      let f' : ((V d ⧸ A') →ₗ[F] B) → Complex := fun M =>
        typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + (h + k)) B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL 0 f
          (M.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap)
      exact .line hA hL 0 f (ih (f := f') (h := h) hypers)

/-- Construct the source-canonical line-first, hyperplane-second tower.
The supplied ambient affine base is used at the first selected step; the
actual A15 recursion uses zero base at every later step. -/
def buildCanonicalSourceTower {n d : Nat} {r l h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A l)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r (h + l) := by
  cases lines with
  | done A => exact buildHyperplanePrefix hypers T
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail =>
      exact .line hA hL T f
        (buildLineSuffix tail hypers (f := fun M =>
          typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + (h + k))
            B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
            (M.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap)))

/-- Every canonical source tower has the exact A14 selected-operator
identities at its chosen line and hyperplane steps. -/
theorem buildCanonicalSourceTower_A14 {n d : Nat} {r l h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A l)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    HasRankedA14Semantics
      (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T) :=
  ranked_tower_has_A14_semantics _

/-- A zero-base hyperplane suffix terminates at the endpoint named by its flag. -/
theorem buildHyperplaneSuffix_endpoint {n d r h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildHyperplaneSuffix (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) flag)).Bend =
      flag.endpoint := by
  induction flag with
  | done B => simp [buildHyperplaneSuffix, rankedTerminalData,
      CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint]
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      simpa [buildHyperplaneSuffix, rankedTerminalData, CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint] using
        (ih (f := fun N => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
          B H hH 0 f
          ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)))

/-- A codomain-only suffix preserves the domain carrier. -/
theorem buildHyperplaneSuffix_Aend {n d r h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildHyperplaneSuffix (r := r) (A := A)
      (f := f) flag)).Aend = A := by
  induction flag with
  | done B => simp [buildHyperplaneSuffix, rankedTerminalData]
  | @cons B H hH k tail ih =>
      simpa [buildHyperplaneSuffix, rankedTerminalData] using
        (ih (f := fun N => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
          B H hH 0 f
          ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype
            B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)))

/-- A hyperplane prefix keeps the same actual terminal carrier. -/
theorem buildHyperplanePrefix_endpoint {n d r h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h) (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildHyperplanePrefix (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) flag T)).Bend =
      flag.endpoint := by
  cases flag with
  | done B => rfl
  | @cons B H hH k tail =>
      simpa [buildHyperplanePrefix, buildHyperplaneSuffix, rankedTerminalData,
        CodomainHyperplaneFlag.endpoint] using
        (buildHyperplaneSuffix_endpoint (r := r) (A := A) (f := fun N =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k) B H hH T f
            ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)) tail)

/-- A hyperplane prefix preserves the domain carrier. -/
theorem buildHyperplanePrefix_Aend {n d r h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (flag : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h) (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildHyperplanePrefix (r := r) (A := A)
      (f := f) flag T)).Aend = A := by
  cases flag with
  | done B => simp [buildHyperplanePrefix, rankedTerminalData]
  | @cons B H hH k tail =>
      simpa [buildHyperplanePrefix, rankedTerminalData] using
        (buildHyperplaneSuffix_Aend (r := r) (A := A) (f := fun N =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k) B H hH T f
            ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp N)) tail)

/-- A line suffix followed by its hyperplane suffix terminates at the named
nested carriers, without replacing either endpoint by an arbitrary witness. -/
theorem buildLineSuffix_endpoints {n d r l h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A l) (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildLineSuffix (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers)).Aend = lines.endpoint ∧
      (rankedTerminalData (buildLineSuffix (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers)).Bend = hypers.endpoint := by
  induction lines with
  | done A =>
      exact ⟨buildHyperplaneSuffix_Aend (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) hypers,
        buildHyperplaneSuffix_endpoint (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) hypers⟩
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail ih =>
      simpa [buildLineSuffix, DomainLineFlag.endpoint, rankedTerminalData] using ih

/-- The canonical source tower terminates at the requested endpoints of its
line and hyperplane flags. -/
theorem buildCanonicalSourceTower_endpoints {n d : Nat} {r l h : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A l) (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Aend =
        lines.endpoint ∧
      (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Bend =
        hypers.endpoint := by
  cases lines with
  | done A =>
      exact ⟨buildHyperplanePrefix_Aend (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) hypers T,
        buildHyperplanePrefix_endpoint (r := r) (A := A) (f := f) hypers T⟩
  | @cons A A' hA hL k tail =>
      simpa [buildCanonicalSourceTower, buildLineSuffix, DomainLineFlag.endpoint, rankedTerminalData] using
        (buildLineSuffix_endpoints (r := r) (f := fun M =>
          typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + (h + k))
        B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
            (M.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap)) tail hypers)

/-- Arbitrary source constraints admit a fully constructed lines-first,
hyperplanes-second A15 tower with the exact requested terminal carriers.
The tower carries the genuine per-step A14 semantics, while this theorem
does not identify its terminal signal with an unproved manuscript operator. -/
theorem exists_canonical_source_tower {n d r : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f : ((V d ⧸ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))) →ₗ[F]
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))) → Complex)
    (T : (V d ⧸ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))) →ₗ[F]
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))) :
    ∃ tower : ActualTypedABRankedTower
        (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) f r
        ((Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) - Module.finrank F B) +
          Module.finrank F A),
      HasRankedA14Semantics tower ∧
        (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend = A ∧
        (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend = B := by
  obtain ⟨lines, hlines, hypers, hhypers⟩ :=
    exists_canonical_source_flags A B
  refine ⟨buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact buildCanonicalSourceTower_A14 (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T
  · exact (buildCanonicalSourceTower_endpoints (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T).1.trans hlines
  · exact (buildCanonicalSourceTower_endpoints (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T).2.trans hhypers

/-- The canonical line-first/hyperplane-second source tower inherits the
actual per-level energy estimate from the original function's globalness;
the carrier, affine base, and terminal rank are those generated above. -/
theorem buildCanonicalSourceTower_energy {n d : Nat} {r l h D : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A l)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B h)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B)
    (hlevel : r + (h + l) ≤ D) :
    ∀ eps : Real, 0 ≤ eps → UpToTypedNormSqGlobal A B (r + (h + l)) eps f →
      (∑ M : ((V d ⧸ (rankedTerminalData
          (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Aend) →ₗ[F]
          (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Bend),
          Complex.normSq ((rankedTerminalData
            (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).fend M)) /
          Fintype.card ((V d ⧸ (rankedTerminalData
            (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Aend) →ₗ[F]
              (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Bend) ≤
        (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
  exact ranked_tower_terminal_energy
    (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)
    hlevel

end
end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualTypedABCanonicalFlag

private abbrev F := ZMod 2
private abbrev V (d : Nat) := Fin d → F
private abbrev W (n : Nat) := Fin n → F

/-- The exact selected-filter identity for an actual line successor, now
expressed on the flattened child carrier `V/A'`. The proof composes the
canonical nested-quotient rank-projection equivalence with the actual fixed-
base typed A14 equation. -/
theorem canonical_line_successor_projection {n d j : Nat}
    (A A' : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (hA : A ≤ A')
    (hL : Module.finrank F (A'.map A.mkQ) = 1)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B)
    (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex)
    (N : ((V d ⧸ A) ⧸ A'.map A.mkQ) →ₗ[F] B) :
    typedComplexRankProjection A' B j
      (fun M => typedLineReducedWitness (k := j) B
        (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
        ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M))
      (BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA N) =
    typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL
      (typedComplexRankProjection A B (j + 1) f)
      (T + N.comp (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ) := by
  calc
    typedComplexRankProjection A' B j
        (fun M => typedLineReducedWitness (k := j) B
          (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
          ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M))
        (BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA N) =
      reducedComplexRankProjection B (A'.map A.mkQ) j
        (typedLineReducedWitness (k := j) B
          (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f) N :=
            BinaryMatrixA15CanonicalLineRank.lineCanonical_rankProjection
              A A' B hA
              (typedLineReducedWitness (k := j) B
                (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f) N
    _ = typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL
        (typedComplexRankProjection A B (j + 1) f)
        (T + N.comp (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ) :=
          typed_A14_fixedLine A B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f N

/-- The exact selected-filter identity for an actual codomain-hyperplane
successor, expressed on its genuine embedded child carrier. As in the line
case, the only transports are the canonical subtype-image equivalence and
the proved fixed-base typed A14 equation. -/
theorem canonical_hyperplane_successor_projection {n d j : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (H : Submodule F B)
    (hH : Module.finrank F (B ⧸ H) = 1)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B)
    (f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex)
    (N : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] H) :
    typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) j
      (fun M => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := j) B H hH T f
        ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M))
      (BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H N) =
    typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
      (typedComplexRankProjection A B (j + 1) f)
      (T + H.subtype.comp N) := by
  calc
    typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) j
        (fun M => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := j) B H hH T f
          ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M))
        (BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H N) =
      hyperplaneReducedComplexRankProjection B H hH j
        (typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := j) B H hH T f) N :=
          BinaryMatrixA15CanonicalRank.hyperplaneCanonical_rankProjection
            B H hH (typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := j) B H hH T f) N
    _ = typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
        (typedComplexRankProjection A B (j + 1) f)
        (T + H.subtype.comp N) :=
          typed_A14_fixedHyperplane A B H hH T f N

/-- Compose the actual selected line and hyperplane filters along the stored
ranked tower. The input is already the selected Fourier level; each
constructor applies its selected filter at the actual affine base and then
continues on the constructor's genuine child carrier. -/
noncomputable def applyCanonicalFilters {n d r k : Nat} {A : Submodule F (V d)}
    {B : Submodule F (W n)} {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (tower : ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r k) :
    (((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex) →
      (((V d ⧸ (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend) →ₗ[F]
        (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend) → Complex) :=
  match tower with
  | .done _ _ => fun g => g
  | @ActualTypedABRankedTower.line n d A B A' hA hL r k T f tail =>
      fun g => applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
        typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL g
          (T + ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M).comp
            (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ))
  | @ActualTypedABRankedTower.hyperplane n d A B H hH r k T f tail =>
      fun g => applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
        typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH g
          (T + H.subtype.comp
            ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M)))

/-- The terminal rank-r projection of the actual recursively constructed
witness equals the composition of the manuscript's selected filters applied
to the original rank-(r+k) projection. This proves the full recursive
projection identity from the canonical successor identities, rather than
assuming a terminal-operator compatibility premise. -/
theorem ranked_terminal_projection_eq_canonicalFilters {n d r k : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex}
    (tower : ActualTypedABRankedTower A B f r k) :
    typedComplexRankProjection (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend
      (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend r (rankedTerminalData tower).fend =
    applyCanonicalFilters tower (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k) f) := by
  induction tower with
  | done f r =>
      simp only [rankedTerminalData, applyCanonicalFilters, Nat.add_zero]
      rfl
  | @line A B A' hA hL r k T f tail ih =>
      have hstep :
          typedComplexRankProjection A' B (r + k)
            (fun M => typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + k) B
              (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
              (M.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap)) =
          (fun M => typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL
            (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
            (T + ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M).comp
              (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ)) := by
        funext M
        let e := BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA
        have hflatten :
            (fun X => typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + k) B
              (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f (e.symm X)) =
            (fun X => typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + k) B
              (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
                (X.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap)) := by
          funext X
          congr 1
        have hs := canonical_line_successor_projection (j := r + k)
          A A' B hA hL T f (e.symm M)
        dsimp only [e] at hs hflatten
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hs
        rw [hflatten] at hs
        exact hs
      have hlevel : r + k + 1 = r + (k + 1) := Nat.add_assoc _ _ _
      rw [hlevel.symm]
      change typedComplexRankProjection (rankedTerminalData tail).Aend
        (rankedTerminalData tail).Bend r (rankedTerminalData tail).fend =
        applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
          typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL
            (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
            (T + ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M).comp
              (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ))
      calc
        typedComplexRankProjection (rankedTerminalData tail).Aend
            (rankedTerminalData tail).Bend r (rankedTerminalData tail).fend =
          applyCanonicalFilters tail
            (typedComplexRankProjection A' B (r + k)
              (fun M => typedLineReducedWitness (k := r + k) B
                (A'.map A.mkQ) hL T f
                (M.comp (nestedDomainEquiv A A' hA).toLinearMap))) := ih
        _ = applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
            typedComplexLineFilter B (A'.map A.mkQ) hL
              (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
              (T + ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedLine.lineCanonicalEquiv A A' B hA).symm M).comp
                (A'.map A.mkQ).mkQ)) :=
          congrArg (applyCanonicalFilters tail) hstep
  | @hyperplane A B H hH r k T f tail ih =>
      have hstep :
          typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) (r + k)
            (fun M => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k) B H hH T f
              ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp M)) =
          (fun M => typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
            (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
            (T + H.subtype.comp
              ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M))) := by
        funext M
        let e : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] H) ≃ₗ[F]
            ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] (H.map B.subtype)) :=
          BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv
            (A := A) B H
        let g0 := fun X : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] (H.map B.subtype)) =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
            B H hH T f (e.symm X)
        let g1 := fun X : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] (H.map B.subtype)) =>
          typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k)
            B H hH T f
            ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype
              B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp X)
        have hflatten : g0 = g1 := by
          funext X
          congr 1
        have hs := canonical_hyperplane_successor_projection (j := r + k)
          A B H hH T f (e.symm M)
        have hcancel : e (e.symm M) = M := e.apply_symm_apply M
        calc
          typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) (r + k) g1 M =
              typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) (r + k) g0 M :=
                (congrArg
                  (fun g => typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype)
                    (r + k) g M) hflatten).symm
          _ = typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) (r + k) g0
                (e (e.symm M)) := by
              exact congrArg
                (fun N => typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype)
                  (r + k) g0 N) hcancel.symm
          _ = typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
                (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
                (T + H.subtype.comp (e.symm M)) := hs
      have hlevel : r + k + 1 = r + (k + 1) := Nat.add_assoc _ _ _
      rw [hlevel.symm]
      change typedComplexRankProjection (rankedTerminalData tail).Aend
        (rankedTerminalData tail).Bend r (rankedTerminalData tail).fend =
        applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
          typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
            (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
            (T + H.subtype.comp
              ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M)))
      calc
        typedComplexRankProjection (rankedTerminalData tail).Aend
            (rankedTerminalData tail).Bend r (rankedTerminalData tail).fend =
          applyCanonicalFilters tail
            (typedComplexRankProjection A (H.map B.subtype) (r + k)
              (fun M => typedHyperplaneReducedWitness (k := r + k) B H hH T f
                ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective B.subtype B.injective_subtype H).symm.toLinearMap.comp M))) := ih
        _ = applyCanonicalFilters tail (fun M =>
            typedComplexHyperplaneFilter B H hH
              (typedComplexRankProjection A B (r + k + 1) f)
              (T + H.subtype.comp
                ((BinaryMatrixA15NestedHyperplane.hyperplaneCanonicalEquiv (A := A) B H).symm M))) :=
          congrArg (applyCanonicalFilters tail) hstep

/-- For the actual bottom-to-A domain flag and top-to-B codomain flag, the
source-canonical first-base/rest-zero tower's residual projection is exactly
the sequential selected-filter composition. This is the full level-rank
identity for the canonical source construction. -/
theorem canonical_source_tower_projection_eq_filters {n d r l h : Nat}
    {A0 : Submodule F (V d)} {B0 : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A0) →ₗ[F] B0) → Complex}
    (lines : DomainLineFlag A0 l)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag B0 h)
    (T : (V d ⧸ A0) →ₗ[F] B0) :
    typedComplexRankProjection
        (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Aend
        (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).Bend
        r (rankedTerminalData (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)).fend =
      applyCanonicalFilters (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)
        (typedComplexRankProjection A0 B0 (r + (h + l)) f) := by
  exact ranked_terminal_projection_eq_canonicalFilters
    (buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := f) lines hypers T)

end

private abbrev F := ZMod 2

/-- Explicitly transports the linear-map carrier when the terminal domain and
codomain subspaces of a canonical flag are identified with the requested
endpoints. The domain map is induced by the equality of quotient carriers;
the codomain map is induced by the submodule equality. -/
def endpointHomEquiv {n d : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A₀ = A₁) (hB : B₀ = B₁) :
    ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) ≃ₗ[F] ((V d ⧸ A₁) →ₗ[F] B₁) := by
  cases hA
  cases hB
  exact LinearEquiv.refl F _

/-- On identical endpoints, endpoint transport is the identity map. -/
theorem endpointHomEquiv_refl {n d : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    endpointHomEquiv rfl rfl M = M := by
  rfl

/-- Endpoint transport along self-equalities is the identity, independent
of the chosen proof terms for those equalities. -/
theorem endpointHomEquiv_self {n d : Nat}
    {A : Submodule F (V d)} {B : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A = A) (hB : B = B) :
    endpointHomEquiv hA hB = LinearEquiv.refl F _ := by
  have hA' : hA = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hB' : hB = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hA', hB']
  rfl

/-- Normalized carrier energy is invariant under endpoint transport. This
uses the explicit finite linear equivalence to reindex both the numerator and
the carrier cardinality; it does not identify dependent function spaces by
ordinary equality. -/
theorem carrierMean_endpoint_transport {n d : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A₀ = A₁) (hB : B₀ = B₁)
    (g : ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) → Real) :
    BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean A₁ B₁
      (fun M => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm M)) =
    BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean A₀ B₀ g := by
  classical
  let e := endpointHomEquiv hA hB
  letI : Fintype (V d ⧸ A₀) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype (V d ⧸ A₁) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype B₀ := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype B₁ := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) := FunLike.fintype _
  letI : Fintype ((V d ⧸ A₁) →ₗ[F] B₁) := FunLike.fintype _
  unfold BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean
  have hsum :
      (∑ M : (V d ⧸ A₁) →ₗ[F] B₁, g (e.symm M)) =
        ∑ M : (V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀, g M := by
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv e.symm.toEquiv
    intro M
    simp
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card ((V d ⧸ A₁) →ₗ[F] B₁) =
        Fintype.card ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) :=
    Fintype.card_congr e.symm.toEquiv
  rw [hsum, hcard]

/-- The energy-specialized form used at the terminal node of a D-collapse. -/
theorem carrierComplexEnergy_endpoint_transport {n d : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A₀ = A₁) (hB : B₀ = B₁)
    (g : ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) → Complex) :
    BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean A₁ B₁
      (fun M => Complex.normSq (g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm M))) =
    BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean A₀ B₀
      (fun M => Complex.normSq (g M)) :=
  carrierMean_endpoint_transport hA hB (fun M => Complex.normSq (g M))

/-- A ranked A15 terminal energy estimate transports to the requested
endpoint carrier through the explicit quotient/codomain linear equivalence.
The estimate still uses globalness of the original input function at rank
`r+k`; no terminal energy premise is supplied by the caller. -/
theorem ranked_tower_endpoint_energy {n d r k D : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    {f : ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) → Complex}
    (tower : ActualTypedABRankedTower A₀ B₀ f r k)
    (hA : (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend = A₁)
    (hB : (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend = B₁)
    (hlevel : r + k ≤ D)
    (eps : Real) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hglobal : UpToTypedNormSqGlobal A₀ B₀ (r + k) eps f) :
    BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean A₁ B₁
      (fun M => Complex.normSq ((rankedTerminalData tower).fend
        ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm M))) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
  have htransport := carrierComplexEnergy_endpoint_transport hA hB
    (rankedTerminalData tower).fend
  rw [htransport]
  simpa [BinaryMatrixA1TypedFourier.carrierMean] using
    ranked_tower_terminal_energy tower hlevel eps heps hglobal

/-- The typed rank projection commutes with endpoint transport. In matrix
coordinates this is the same projection, so its Fourier rank and trace
pairing are the ones already transported by `carrierTypedRankProjection_coordinate`
and `carrierFrequency_character`. -/
theorem endpointProjection_natural {n d j : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A₀ = A₁) (hB : B₀ = B₁)
    (g : ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) → Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) :
    typedComplexRankProjection A₀ B₀ j g M =
    typedComplexRankProjection A₁ B₁ j
      (fun N => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm N))
      (endpointHomEquiv hA hB M) := by
  cases hA
  cases hB
  rfl

/-- The endpoint projection identity written in the accepted Fourier matrix
coordinates of the terminal carrier. The coordinate theorem expands the
projection as the rank-filtered finite character sum; its proof uses the
transpose-aware frequency equivalence and trace-pairing identity. -/
theorem endpointProjection_coordinate_bridge {n d j : Nat}
    {A₀ A₁ : Submodule F (V d)} {B₀ B₁ : Submodule F (W n)}
    (hA : A₀ = A₁) (hB : B₀ = B₁)
    (g : ((V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) → Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A₀) →ₗ[F] B₀) :
    carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A₀ B₀ j g M =
      complexRankProjection j
        (fun X => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm
          ((carrierMatrixEquiv A₁ B₁).symm X)))
        (carrierMatrixEquiv A₁ B₁ (endpointHomEquiv hA hB M)) := by
  calc
    carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A₀ B₀ j g M =
        typedComplexRankProjection A₀ B₀ j g M :=
      carrierTypedRankProjection_eq_A14Line (j := j) A₀ B₀ g M
    _ = typedComplexRankProjection A₁ B₁ j
        (fun N => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm N))
        (endpointHomEquiv hA hB M) := endpointProjection_natural hA hB g M
    _ = carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A₁ B₁ j
        (fun N => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm N))
        (endpointHomEquiv hA hB M) :=
      (carrierTypedRankProjection_eq_A14Line (j := j) A₁ B₁ _ _).symm
    _ = complexRankProjection j
        (fun X => g ((endpointHomEquiv hA hB).symm
          ((carrierMatrixEquiv A₁ B₁).symm X)))
        (carrierMatrixEquiv A₁ B₁ (endpointHomEquiv hA hB M)) :=
      carrierTypedRankProjection_coordinate A₁ B₁ _ _

end
end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualTypedABEndpointTransport

This file first records the exact finite reconstruction after the selected

private abbrev F := ZMod 2
private abbrev V (d : Nat) := Fin d → F
private abbrev W (n : Nat) := Fin n → F

private def complexRealDot (z w : Complex) : Real :=
  z.re * w.re + z.im * w.im

/-- Distinct typed carrier rank projections are orthogonal in the actual
normalized carrier mean. The proof transports to the genuine coordinate
matrix space and uses Fourier Parseval support; it does not assume an
orthogonality premise for the full A16 assembly. -/
theorem typedComplexRankProjection_cross_orthogonal {n d i j : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f g : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    carrierMean A B (fun M => complexRealDot
      (typedComplexRankProjection A B i f M)
      (typedComplexRankProjection A B j g M)) = 0 := by
  let fCoord : BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B)
      (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A)) → Complex :=
    fun X => f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)
  let gCoord : BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B)
      (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A)) → Complex :=
    fun X => g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)
  have hfi (X : BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B)
      (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A))) :
      typedComplexRankProjection A B i f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) =
        complexRankProjection i fCoord X := by
    calc
      typedComplexRankProjection A B i f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) =
          carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A B i f
            ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) :=
        (carrierTypedRankProjection_eq_A14Line A B f
          ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)).symm
      _ = complexRankProjection i fCoord X := by
        rw [carrierTypedRankProjection_coordinate]
        simp only [fCoord, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hgj (X : BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B)
      (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A))) :
      typedComplexRankProjection A B j g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) =
        complexRankProjection j gCoord X := by
    calc
      typedComplexRankProjection A B j g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) =
          carrierTypedComplexRankProjection A B j g
            ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X) :=
        (carrierTypedRankProjection_eq_A14Line A B g
          ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)).symm
      _ = complexRankProjection j gCoord X := by
        rw [carrierTypedRankProjection_coordinate]
        simp only [gCoord, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [carrierMean_coordinate]
  have hreal :
      uniformMean (fun X =>
        (complexRankProjection i fCoord X).re *
          (complexRankProjection j gCoord X).re) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [complexRankProjection_re]
    exact ActualBinaryMatrixHC46FourierA16.rankProjection_inner_eq_zero
      (fun X => (fCoord X).re) (fun X => (gCoord X).re) hij
  have himag :
      uniformMean (fun X =>
        (complexRankProjection i fCoord X).im *
          (complexRankProjection j gCoord X).im) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [complexRankProjection_im]
    exact ActualBinaryMatrixHC46FourierA16.rankProjection_inner_eq_zero
      (fun X => (fCoord X).im) (fun X => (gCoord X).im) hij
  unfold uniformMean at hreal himag
  have hdot :
      (fun X => complexRealDot
        (typedComplexRankProjection A B i f ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X))
        (typedComplexRankProjection A B j g ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X))) =
      (fun X =>
        (complexRankProjection i fCoord X).re *
          (complexRankProjection j gCoord X).re +
        (complexRankProjection i fCoord X).im *
          (complexRankProjection j gCoord X).im) := by
    funext X
    simp only [complexRealDot, hfi X, hgj X]
  rw [hdot]
  unfold uniformMean
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div, hreal, himag]
  ring

/-- Complex squared energy is additive across any finite orthogonal family on
an actual typed carrier. This is the carrier-coordinate transport of the
finite Parseval identity, with orthogonality as the only analytic premise. -/
theorem carrierEnergy_finite_sum_of_orthogonal {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex)
    (horth : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      carrierMean A B (fun M => complexRealDot (g i M) (g j M)) = 0) :
    carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (∑ i ∈ s, g i M)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (g i M)) := by
  let gCoord : ι → BinaryMatrix (Module.finrank F B)
      (Module.finrank F (V d ⧸ A)) → Complex :=
    fun i X => g i ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)
  have horthCoord : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j →
      uniformMean (fun X => complexRealDot (gCoord i X) (gCoord j X)) = 0 := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    simpa only [gCoord, carrierMean_coordinate] using horth i hi j hj hij
  have henergy := ActualBinaryMatrixHC46CommonA16.complexEnergy_finite_sum_of_orthogonal
    s gCoord horthCoord
  have hcoordSum :
      (fun X => ∑ i ∈ s, gCoord i X) =
        fun X => (∑ i ∈ s, g i ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X)) := by
    funext X
    simp [gCoord]
  calc
    carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (∑ i ∈ s, g i M)) =
        uniformMean (fun X => Complex.normSq
          (∑ i ∈ s, g i ((carrierMatrixEquiv A B).symm X))) :=
      carrierMean_coordinate A B _
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, uniformMean (fun X => Complex.normSq (gCoord i X)) := by
      change uniformMean (fun X => Complex.normSq (∑ i ∈ s, gCoord i X)) = _
      exact henergy
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, carrierMean A B
          (fun M => Complex.normSq (g i M)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      symm
      exact carrierMean_coordinate A B _

private theorem complexFourierCoeff_add {n d : Nat}
    (f g : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex) (Y : BinaryMatrix n d) :
    complexFourierCoeff (fun M => f M + g M) Y =
      complexFourierCoeff f Y + complexFourierCoeff g Y := by
  unfold complexFourierCoeff
  simp_rw [add_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div]

private theorem complexAmbientHybridFilter_add {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f g : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex) (M : BinaryMatrix n d) :
    complexAmbientHybridFilter A B (fun X => f X + g X) M =
      complexAmbientHybridFilter A B f M +
        complexAmbientHybridFilter A B g M := by
  unfold complexAmbientHybridFilter
  simp_rw [complexFourierCoeff_add, add_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro Y hY
  by_cases hsel : Selected A B Y.transpose.toLin'
  <;> simp [hsel]

private theorem complexAmbientHybridFilter_finset_sum {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (M : BinaryMatrix n d) :
    complexAmbientHybridFilter A B (fun X => ∑ i ∈ s, g i X) M =
      ∑ i ∈ s, complexAmbientHybridFilter A B (g i) M := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [complexAmbientHybridFilter, complexFourierCoeff]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [complexAmbientHybridFilter_add, ih]

private theorem filteredCarrierFunction_finset_sum {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι)
    (g : ι → BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    filteredCarrierFunction A B T (fun X => ∑ i ∈ s, g i X) M =
      ∑ i ∈ s, filteredCarrierFunction A B T (g i) M := by
  unfold filteredCarrierFunction complexAmbientAffineRestrict
  exact complexAmbientHybridFilter_finset_sum A B s g
    (LinearMap.toMatrix' (T + B.subtype.comp (M.comp A.mkQ)))

/-- The selected-frequency predicate forces the matrix rank to pay for both
the constrained input subspace and the unconstrained output quotient. -/
theorem selected_frequency_rank_lower_bound {n d : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (Y : BinaryMatrix n d)
    (hsel : Selected A B Y.transpose.toLin') :
    Module.finrank F A + Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) ≤ Y.rank := by
  let L : W n →ₗ[F] V d := Y.transpose.toLin'
  let qL : W n →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A) := A.mkQ.comp L
  let R : Submodule F (V d) := LinearMap.range L
  let AR : Submodule F R := A.comap R.subtype
  let qR : R →ₗ[F] (V d ⧸ A) := A.mkQ.comp R.subtype
  have hAR : A ≤ R := hsel.1
  have hARdim : Module.finrank F AR = Module.finrank F A := by
    exact (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hAR).finrank_eq
  have hkerR : LinearMap.ker qR = AR := by
    simp [qR, AR, LinearMap.ker_comp]
  have hfactor : qL = qR.comp L.rangeRestrict := by
    ext x
    rfl
  have hqrange : LinearMap.range qL = LinearMap.range qR := by
    rw [hfactor]
    exact LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top qR
      (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict L)
  have hqrank : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range qL) =
      Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range qR) :=
    congrArg (fun S : Submodule F (V d ⧸ A) => Module.finrank F S) hqrange
  have hnullR := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker qR
  have hdimR : Module.finrank F R =
      Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range qL) + Module.finrank F A := by
    rw [hqrank]
    rw [hkerR, hARdim] at hnullR
    exact hnullR.symm
  have hmatrixRank : Y.rank = Module.finrank F R := by
    change Matrix.rank Y = Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range L)
    rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose Y]
    rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin Y.transpose
      (Pi.basisFun F _) (Pi.basisFun F _)]
    rw [Matrix.toLin_eq_toLin']
  have hkerBound : LinearMap.ker qL ≤ B := by
    intro x hx
    have hxzero : A.mkQ (L x) = 0 := by
      simpa [qL, LinearMap.mem_ker] using hx
    have hxA : L x ∈ A := by
      have hmem : L x ∈ LinearMap.ker A.mkQ :=
        LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hxzero
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ] at hmem
      exact hmem
    exact hsel.2 x hxA
  have hnullL := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker qL
  have hkerDim : Module.finrank F (LinearMap.ker qL) ≤ Module.finrank F B :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono hkerBound
  have hquotB := (B.finrank_quotient_add_finrank)
  have hqLower : Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) ≤
      Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range qL) := by omega
  rw [hmatrixRank, hdimR]
  omega

/-- A rank projection below the selected-carrier threshold is annihilated by
the actual hybrid filter, independently of ambient matrix width. -/
theorem complexAmbientHybridFilter_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
    {n d i : Nat} (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hi : i < Module.finrank F A + Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B)) :
    complexAmbientHybridFilter A B (complexRankProjection i f) = 0 := by
  funext M
  unfold complexAmbientHybridFilter
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro Y hY
  by_cases hsel : Selected A B Y.transpose.toLin'
  · have hnot : Y.rank ≠ i := by
      have hrank := selected_frequency_rank_lower_bound A B Y hsel
      omega
    simp [hsel, complexRankProjection_fourier_support f Y hnot]
  · simp [hsel]

/-- The same low-rank annihilation holds after the actual affine carrier
restriction. -/
theorem filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
    {n d i : Nat} (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hi : i < Module.finrank F A + Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B)) :
    filteredCarrierFunction A B T (complexRankProjection i f) = 0 := by
  unfold filteredCarrierFunction complexAmbientAffineRestrict
  rw [complexAmbientHybridFilter_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
    A B f hi]
  funext M
  simp

/-- Each retained rank level inherits the canonical A16 bound from the
original actual globalness premise. The endpoint equalities identify the
source-chosen tower with the requested arbitrary typed carriers. -/
theorem filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_energy_bound
    {n d i l h D : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (lines : DomainLineFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) l)
    (hlines : lines.endpoint = A)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) h)
    (hhypers : hypers.endpoint = B)
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (eps : Real) (heps : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hglobal : UpToActualNormSqGlobal D eps f)
    (hpositive : l + h ≠ 0) (hlevel : l + h ≤ i) (hi : i ≤ D) :
    carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq
      (filteredCarrierFunction A B T (complexRankProjection i f) M)) ≤
        (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
  let source : ((V d ⧸ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))) →ₗ[F]
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))) → Complex := fun M =>
    filteredCarrierFunction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M
  let r := i - (h + l)
  let T0 := initialBottomTopBase T
  let tower := buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := source)
    lines hypers T0
  have hsource : source =
      (fun M => f (bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv M)) := by
    funext M
    calc
      filteredCarrierFunction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
          (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M =
        f (LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (0 + (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)).subtype.comp
            (M.comp (Submodule.mkQ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)))))) := by
              simpa only [zero_add] using
                (filteredCarrierFunction_bot_top_base f 0 M)
      _ = f (bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv M) := by
        rw [bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv_apply]
        simp
  have hglobalTyped := actual_global_to_bottomTop_typed f hglobal
  rw [← hsource] at hglobalTyped
  have hidx : r + (h + l) = i := by
    dsimp [r]
    omega
  have hglobalI : UpToTypedNormSqGlobal
      (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) i eps source := by
    intro Q hQ
    exact hglobalTyped Q (hQ.trans hi)
  have hbound := canonical_source_rank_projection_energy
    (r := r) lines hypers T f hpositive (by simpa only [hidx] using hi)
    eps heps (by simpa only [hidx] using hglobalI)
  have hends := buildCanonicalSourceTower_endpoints
    (r := r) (f := source) lines hypers T0
  have hAend : (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend = A := hends.1.trans hlines
  have hBend : (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend = B := hends.2.trans hhypers
  change carrierMean (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend
      (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend
      (fun M => Complex.normSq (filteredCarrierFunction
        (rankedTerminalData tower).Aend (rankedTerminalData tower).Bend T
        (complexRankProjection (r + (h + l)) f) M)) ≤ _ at hbound
  rw [hAend, hBend, hidx] at hbound
  exact hbound

/-- The actual source's globalness implies a nonnegative energy parameter;
this is used only as the scalar factor in the final finite sum. -/
theorem filteredCarrierFunction_parameter_nonneg {n d D : Nat}
    {eps : Real} (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hglobal : UpToActualNormSqGlobal D eps f) : 0 ≤ eps :=
  actual_source_parameter_nonneg f hglobal

/-- The literal finite rank reconstruction commutes with the actual selected
hybrid filter and the chosen affine carrier restriction. It is valid for
arbitrary carriers, bases, and ambient widths; the only degree premise is the
source Fourier coefficient support predicate. -/
theorem filteredCarrierFunction_reconstruct_range_of_support
    {n d D : Nat} (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hsupport : ComplexFourierSupportedThrough D f)
    (M : (V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
      filteredCarrierFunction A B T (complexRankProjection i f) M) =
      filteredCarrierFunction A B T f M := by
  have hsource :
      (fun X => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), complexRankProjection i f X) = f := by
    funext X
    exact complexRankProjection_reconstruct_range_of_support f hsupport X
  rw [← filteredCarrierFunction_finset_sum A B T
    (Finset.range (D + 1)) (fun i => complexRankProjection i f) M]
  exact congrArg (fun g : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex =>
    filteredCarrierFunction A B T g M) hsource

end
end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualTypedABFullA16Assembly

namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualTypedABFullA16Final

private abbrev F := ZMod 2
private abbrev V (d : Nat) := Fin d → F
private abbrev W (n : Nat) := Fin n → F

private def complexRealDotFinal (z w : Complex) : Real :=
  z.re * w.re + z.im * w.im

private theorem succ_le_two_pow (m : Nat) : m + 1 ≤ 2 ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ m ih =>
      calc
        m + 1 + 1 ≤ 2 * (m + 1) := by omega
        _ ≤ 2 * 2 ^ m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ih
        _ = 2 ^ (m + 1) := by simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

private theorem count_le_two_pow_sq (D : Nat) : D + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (D ^ 2) := by
  by_cases hD : D = 0
  · simp [hD]
  have hDpos : 1 ≤ D := by omega
  have hDsquare : D ≤ D ^ 2 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using (Nat.le_mul_self D)
  exact (succ_le_two_pow D).trans
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two hDsquare)

/-- Every retained rank projection is the residual typed projection of its
own source-canonical tower, transported to the requested endpoint carrier.
The same original source is used at every rank; only the residual rank changes. -/
private theorem retained_rank_representation {n d i l h : Nat}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (lines : DomainLineFlag (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) l)
    (hlines : lines.endpoint = A)
    (hypers : CodomainHyperplaneFlag (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) h)
    (hhypers : hypers.endpoint = B)
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hpositive : l + h ≠ 0) (hlevel : l + h ≤ i) :
    ∃ φ : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex,
      (fun M => filteredCarrierFunction A B T
        (complexRankProjection i f) M) =
        typedComplexRankProjection A B (i - (h + l)) φ := by
  let r := i - (l + h)
  let source : ((V d ⧸ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))) →ₗ[F]
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))) → Complex := fun M =>
    filteredCarrierFunction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
      (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M
  let tower := buildCanonicalSourceTower (r := r) (f := source)
    lines hypers (initialBottomTopBase T)
  let hends := buildCanonicalSourceTower_endpoints
    (r := r) (f := source) lines hypers (initialBottomTopBase T)
  let hA := hends.1.trans hlines
  let hB := hends.2.trans hhypers
  let e := endpointHomEquiv hA hB
  let φ : ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex := fun M =>
    (rankedTerminalData tower).fend (e.symm M)
  have hmain := arbitrary_carrier_rank_projection_identity (i := i)
    A B lines hlines hypers hhypers T f hpositive hlevel
  dsimp only at hmain
  have hidx : i - (h + l) = i - (l + h) := by omega
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [← hidx] using hmain.symm

/-- Arbitrary typed carriers, arbitrary affine base, and arbitrary ambient
width: Fourier support through `D` together with the original actual
up-to-`D` global bound implies the full A16 carrier-energy bound. The proof
derives parameter nonnegativity, treats zero carrier cost directly, removes
unselected low ranks, and sums the orthogonal residual-rank levels. -/
theorem filteredCarrierFunction_energy_le_A16
    {n d D : Nat} {eps : Real}
    (A : Submodule F (V d)) (B : Submodule F (W n))
    (T : V d →ₗ[F] W n) (f : BinaryMatrix n d → Complex)
    (hsupport : ComplexFourierSupportedThrough D f)
    (hglobal : UpToActualNormSqGlobal D eps f) :
    carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq
      (filteredCarrierFunction A B T f M)) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ (11 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
  let l := Module.finrank F A
  let h := Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) - Module.finrank F B
  let k := l + h
  obtain ⟨lines, hlines, hypers, hhypers⟩ :=
    exists_canonical_source_flags A B
  have hquot := B.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  have htop : Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) =
      Module.finrank F (W n) := bottomTopCodomainEquiv.finrank_eq
  have hcod : h = Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) := by
    dsimp [h]
    omega
  have hk : k = Module.finrank F A + Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) := by
    dsimp [k, l]
    rw [hcod]
  have heps : 0 ≤ eps := filteredCarrierFunction_parameter_nonneg f hglobal
  by_cases hkzero : k = 0
  · have hlzero : l = 0 := by dsimp [k] at hkzero; omega
    have hhzero : h = 0 := by dsimp [k] at hkzero; omega
    have hA_dim : Module.finrank F A = 0 := by simpa [l] using hlzero
    have hA : A = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp hA_dim
    have hB_dim : Module.finrank F B =
        Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) := by
      have hhzero' : Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) -
          Module.finrank F B = 0 := by simpa [h] using hhzero
      have hBle : Module.finrank F B ≤
          Module.finrank F (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) :=
        Submodule.finrank_mono le_top
      omega
    have hB : B = ⊤ := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq le_top hB_dim
    rw [hA, hB]
    let Z : Submodule F (W n) := ⊤
    let Q0 : CarrierRestriction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) Z :=
      ⟨⊥, (⊤ : Submodule F Z), 0⟩
    have htyped := actual_global_to_bottomTop_typed f hglobal
    have hsource :
        (fun M => filteredCarrierFunction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
          (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M) =
        (fun M => f (bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv M)) := by
      funext M
      rw [filteredCarrierFunction_bot_top, bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv_apply]
    have hqTop := (⊤ : Submodule F Z).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    rw [finrank_top] at hqTop
    have hq0 : Module.finrank F (Z ⧸ (⊤ : Submodule F Z)) = 0 := by omega
    have hzero_mean : carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
        (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
        (fun M => Complex.normSq (filteredCarrierFunction
          (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M)) ≤ eps := by
      have hQorder : Q0.order ≤ D := by
        simpa [Q0, CarrierRestriction.order, Z, finrank_bot, hq0] using
          (Nat.zero_le D)
      have hQ := htyped Q0 hQorder
      have hfibre : Q0.fibre = Finset.univ := by
        ext M
        simp [Q0, CarrierRestriction.fibre]
      rw [hfibre] at hQ
      simp only [Finset.card_univ] at hQ
      with_unfolding_all
        change carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
          (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
          (fun M => Complex.normSq (f (bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv M))) ≤ eps at hQ
      have hmeanEq :
          carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
            (fun M => Complex.normSq (filteredCarrierFunction
              (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M)) =
          carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
            (fun M => Complex.normSq (f (bottomTopAmbientMatrixEquiv M))) :=
        congrArg (fun q => carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
          (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) (fun M => Complex.normSq (q M))) hsource
      exact hmeanEq.symm ▸ hQ
    let T0 := initialBottomTopBase T
    have hmean := zero_step_carrier_energy_mean T0 f
    have hbase : (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)).subtype.comp
        (T0.comp (Submodule.mkQ (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)))) = T :=
      initialBottomTopBase_ambient T
    have hshift : carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
        (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
        (fun M => Complex.normSq (filteredCarrierFunction
          (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) T f M)) =
      carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
        (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
        (fun M => Complex.normSq (filteredCarrierFunction
          (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) 0 f M)) := by
      simpa [hbase] using hmean
    calc
      carrierMean (⊥ : Submodule F (V d)) (⊤ : Submodule F (W n))
          (fun M => Complex.normSq
            (filteredCarrierFunction (⊥ : Submodule F (V d))
              (⊤ : Submodule F (W n)) T f M)) = _ := hshift
      _ ≤ eps := hzero_mean
      _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (11 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
        have hfactor : (1 : Real) ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (11 * D ^ 2) := by exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        calc
          eps = 1 * eps := by ring
          _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (11 * D ^ 2) * eps :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfactor heps
  · have hkpos : k ≠ 0 := hkzero
    let levels : Finset Nat := Finset.range (D + 1)
    let g : Nat → ((V d ⧸ A) →ₗ[F] B) → Complex := fun i M =>
      filteredCarrierFunction A B T (complexRankProjection i f) M
    have hlevel (i : Nat) (hi : i ∈ levels) :
        carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq (g i M)) ≤
          (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
      have hiD : i ≤ D := by
        exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      by_cases hlow : i < k
      · have hlowNorm : i < Module.finrank F A +
            Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) := by
          simpa only [← hk] using hlow
        have hz := filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
          (i := i) A B T f hlowNorm
        have hzero : g i = fun _ => 0 := by
          funext M
          exact congrFun hz M
        rw [hzero]
        simp only [Complex.normSq_zero, carrierMean,
          Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div]
        exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : Real) ≤ 2) _) heps
      · have hki : k ≤ i := by omega
        have hkpos' : l + h ≠ 0 := by
          change k ≠ 0
          exact hkpos
        have hki' : l + h ≤ i := by
          change k ≤ i
          exact hki
        exact filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_energy_bound
          (i := i) (l := l) (h := h) A B
          lines hlines hypers hhypers T f eps heps hglobal
          hkpos' hki' hiD
    have horth : ∀ i ∈ levels, ∀ j ∈ levels, i ≠ j →
        carrierMean A B (fun M => complexRealDotFinal (g i M) (g j M)) = 0 := by
      intro i hi j hj hij
      by_cases hilo : i < k
      · have hlowNorm : i < Module.finrank F A +
            Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) := by
          simpa only [← hk] using hilo
        have hz := filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
          (i := i) A B T f hlowNorm
        have hzero : g i = fun _ => 0 := by
          funext M
          exact congrFun hz M
        simp [complexRealDotFinal, hzero, carrierMean,
          Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div]
      · by_cases hjlo : j < k
        · have hlowNorm : j < Module.finrank F A +
              Module.finrank F (W n ⧸ B) := by
            simpa only [← hk] using hjlo
          have hz := filteredCarrierFunction_rankProjection_zero_of_below_carrier
            (i := j) A B T f hlowNorm
          have hzero : g j = fun _ => 0 := by
            funext M
            exact congrFun hz M
          simp [complexRealDotFinal, hzero, carrierMean,
            Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div]
        · have hik : k ≤ i := by omega
          have hjk : k ≤ j := by omega
          have hkpos' : l + h ≠ 0 := by
            change k ≠ 0
            exact hkpos
          have hik' : l + h ≤ i := by
            change k ≤ i
            exact hik
          have hjk' : l + h ≤ j := by
            change k ≤ j
            exact hjk
          obtain ⟨phiI, hri⟩ := retained_rank_representation
            (i := i) (l := l) (h := h) A B lines hlines hypers hhypers T f
            hkpos' hik'
          obtain ⟨phiJ, hrj⟩ := retained_rank_representation
            (i := j) (l := l) (h := h) A B lines hlines hypers hhypers T f
            hkpos' hjk'
          have hgi : g i = typedComplexRankProjection A B (i - (h + l)) phiI := by
            simpa only [g] using hri
          have hgj : g j = typedComplexRankProjection A B (j - (h + l)) phiJ := by
            simpa only [g] using hrj
          have hres : i - k ≠ j - k := by omega
          have hres' : i - (h + l) ≠ j - (h + l) := by
            dsimp [k] at hres
            omega
          rw [hgi, hgj]
          with_unfolding_all
            exact typedComplexRankProjection_cross_orthogonal A B phiI phiJ hres'
    have hsumEnergy := carrierEnergy_finite_sum_of_orthogonal
      A B levels g horth
    have hdecomp : (fun M => ∑ i ∈ levels, g i M) =
        fun M => filteredCarrierFunction A B T f M := by
      funext M
      exact filteredCarrierFunction_reconstruct_range_of_support
        A B T f hsupport M
    have henergy : carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq
        (filteredCarrierFunction A B T f M)) =
        ∑ i ∈ levels, carrierMean A B
          (fun M => Complex.normSq (g i M)) := by
      calc
        _ = carrierMean A B
            (fun M => Complex.normSq (∑ i ∈ levels, g i M)) := by
              congr 1
              funext M
              exact congrArg Complex.normSq (congrFun hdecomp M).symm
        _ = _ := hsumEnergy
    calc
      carrierMean A B (fun M => Complex.normSq
          (filteredCarrierFunction A B T f M)) =
        ∑ i ∈ levels, carrierMean A B
          (fun M => Complex.normSq (g i M)) := henergy
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ levels, ((2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (by
          intro i hi
          exact hlevel i hi)
      _ = (D + 1 : Real) * ((2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps) := by
        simp [levels]
      _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (D ^ 2) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2) * eps) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (by exact_mod_cast count_le_two_pow_sq D)
          (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : Real) ≤ 2) _) heps)
      _ = ((2 : Real) ^ (D ^ 2) *
          (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D ^ 2)) * eps := by ring
      _ = (2 : Real) ^ (11 * D ^ 2) * eps := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        ring

end
